reviews.reason: Move the king off a mating h-file alignment in a queen ending and keep the h1 escape.
reviews.distinctness: Move the king off a mating h-file alignment in a queen ending and keep the h1 escape.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Kh2 để tránh đòn Qh1#. Nếu Đen chuyển sang chiếu Qf2+, Vua trắng vẫn có ô h1 để thoát.
hintsVi: Nếu Hậu đen chiếu ở h1, các Tốt trắng đang cản Vua thoát qua những ô nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Move the king off a mating h-file alignment in a queen ending and keep the h1 escape.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: The tempting passed-pawn push e6 or a queen move such as Qd3 allows ...Qh1#. Kh2 is the only root with an adequate score.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: The strong ...Qf2+ lets the king go to h1, and ...Qxg3+ simply loses the attacking queen to Kxg3.
reviewNotes.level: The named defensive change is immediate. Legal captures and strongest replies do not require a deliberate sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game at ply 118, with exact source frame and preceding move, played Kh2. Archive https://theweekinchess.com/zips/twic1664g.zip; checksum 87bcd88e628c85b6e7e5b36894738fc9e6ef4012345740e57ff05795a908940f.

reviews.reason: The knight covers the precise mating square and attacks the queen on the same move.
reviews.distinctness: A knight on the rim both guards g8 and attacks f7, where the queen stands.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi Nh6. Mã từ h6 khống chế g8 và tấn công Hậu trên f7. Nếu Trắng chiếu Qg8+ thì Đen bắt lại bằng Nxg8.
hintsVi: Hậu trắng dọa Qg8#. Mã đen có thể vừa giữ g8 vừa tấn công Hậu từ ô nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Nh6 answers Qg8# with Nxg8 and attacks the queen on f7.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Bxd5 leaves White a strong Qxd5 continuation. Re2+ can defer the issue but Kf1 leaves Black with an inferior version of Nh6.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qc7 Bxd5 is the strongest tested branch. The checks Qf8+, Qe8+, and Qxg7+ have direct replies. The stationary c6 bishop can be recaptured by bxc6 if taken.
reviewNotes.level: A single knight move denies the mating square and makes the attacker move.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.27) replayed through ply 63 and to the end. Kg2 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Nh6. Source SHA-256 87bcd88e628c85b6e7e5b36894738fc9e6ef4012345740e57ff05795a908940f.

reviews.reason: Either of two pawns can remove the pawn that makes the h2 checkmate work.
reviews.distinctness: Two legal recaptures remove the pawn supporter, with different pawn structures and the actual game choosing the f-pawn.
reviews.solutionVi: Trong phương án luyện tập, Trắng đi hxg3. Trong ván đấu, Trắng chọn fxg3. Cả hai nước đều loại Tốt đen bảo vệ h2, nên nếu Hậu đen chiếu Qh2+ thì Vua trắng có thể bắt Hậu.
hintsVi: Tốt đen trên g3 bảo vệ ô nào? Trắng có thể dùng những Tốt nào để bắt nó?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The black pawn on g3 protects h2. Either pawn capture removes that guard so a queen check on h2 can be answered by Kxh2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: fxg3 is the actual move and is verified as an alternative. h4 still leaves a dangerous attack after gxf2+ and does not remove the supporting pawn.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Rab8 and b6 keep the position active. Qh2+ permits Kxh2 and Qh1+ permits Qxh1. No immediate black capture can take either the moved pawn or a stationary defender.
reviewNotes.level: Both options remove the support in one move. The copy identifies the source branch.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 6th Final Masters game (2013.10.08) replayed through ply 36 and to the end. fxg3 reaches the exercise; the next played move is fxg3. Source SHA-256 d9fa17c7a3dab9c76627e93d00bf0c6f70dbe6deb12289b71a4c34ec4601fcc5.

reviews.reason: Vacate f7 with the f-pawn against a rook-supported h-file mate.
reviews.distinctness: Vacate f7 with the f-pawn against a rook-supported h-file mate.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi f6, dọn ô f7 cho Vua. Nếu Trắng vẫn chiếu Qh8+, Vua có thể đến f7. Đẩy Tốt thông d3 ngay sẽ để lọt Qh8#.
hintsVi: Nếu Hậu trắng đến h8, Vua đen có thể thoát qua ô nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Vacate f7 with the f-pawn against a rook-supported h-file mate.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: The tempting passed pawn push ...d3 permits Qh8#. ...f5 and ...Kf8 also avoid immediate mate, but give up more of the position in the full-root comparison.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: The strongest replies include Rd3 and Qg4. Qxf6 is met by ...gxf6, a queen-for-pawn exchange in Black’s favour.
reviewNotes.level: The named defensive change is immediate. Legal captures and strongest replies do not require a deliberate sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete TCh-ESP Rapid 2026 game at ply 57, with exact source frame and preceding move, played f6. Archive https://theweekinchess.com/zips/twic1666g.zip; checksum 7ad2cff3c1bc2f2ea33cf669cbe5f41efd62613584eb95cc95bd74fc2d4e3911.

reviews.reason: Move the mating target to a square guarded by the king.
reviews.distinctness: Move the mating target to a square guarded by the king.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Rc1, rút Xe khỏi e1. Nếu Đen bắt bằng Qxc1+ thì Vua bắt lại Kxc1. Qf1 cũng hóa giải đe dọa bằng cách bảo vệ Xe trên e1.
hintsVi: Xe e1 có thể chuyển đến ô nào được Vua trắng bảo vệ?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Move the mating target to a square guarded by the king.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qc8 and a number of other queen moves leave Qxe1#. Qf1 is a verified alternative that protects e1 without moving the rook.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: ...b4 keeps the position competitive. ...Qxc1+ allows Kxc1, winning the queen for the rook; ...Qxh2 concerns a separate pawn, not a sacrifice of the defensive rook.
reviewNotes.level: The named defensive change is immediate. Legal captures and strongest replies do not require a deliberate sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Fagernes GM Swiss Aut game at ply 54, with exact source frame and preceding move, played Rc1. Archive https://theweekinchess.com/zips/twic1666g.zip; checksum 7ad2cff3c1bc2f2ea33cf669cbe5f41efd62613584eb95cc95bd74fc2d4e3911.

reviews.reason: The rook capture removes one mating attacker and defends the entry square used by the other.
reviews.distinctness: One capture answers two different mates on h7. The king capture lacks the rook’s coverage and exposes the king.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi Rxg7, bắt Xe trắng và dùng Xe của mình bảo vệ h7. Nếu Trắng thử Qh7+ thì Kxh7. Bắt bằng Vua trên g7 để Vua lộ ra trước các nước chiếu tiếp theo.
hintsVi: Hậu và Xe trắng đều nhắm tới h7. Quân nào của Đen có thể bắt Xe trên g7 mà vẫn khống chế h7?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: After a pass both Rh7# and Qh7# are legal. Rxg7 takes the first attacker and stops the second mate.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Kxg7 removes the rook but leaves a much worse king position. Qg6 fails to the remaining attack. Moving the rook along the back rank leaves a mate on h7.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Bxc5 Qxc5 and Bf2 Qd6 are the strongest tested continuations. Rxh6+ has a legal Qxh6 reply. The rook capture gains the attacking rook without a material offer.
reviewNotes.level: A direct capture answers both threats in one move. Any continuation is illustrative.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 22nd Chefchaouen Op 2026 game (2026.10.20) replayed through ply 81 and to the end. Rxg7 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Rxg7. Source SHA-256 d455919e2736370933e89e106c114a348807cc26acae4bd4b9b78ade35bcdf4e.

reviews.reason: Quiet pawn interposition on e3 cuts the queen’s b6–f2 diagonal and can be recaptured by two pieces.
reviews.distinctness: Quiet pawn interposition on e3 cuts the queen’s b6–f2 diagonal and can be recaptured by two pieces.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi e3 để chặn đường chéo b6–f2 của Hậu đen. Nếu Đen bắt Qxe3, Trắng có thể bắt lại bằng Rxe3 hoặc fxe3.
hintsVi: Tìm ô trống trên đường chéo từ b6 đến f2 mà một Tốt trắng có thể chặn.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Quiet pawn interposition on e3 cuts the queen’s b6–f2 diagonal and can be recaptured by two pieces.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Ra1 and Ng6 leave ...Qxf2#. Be4 is a different interposition but ranks substantially below e3 in the root comparison.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: ...Rf7 and ...Qa6 are among the strongest replies. ...Qxe3 loses the queen to Rxe3 or fxe3.
reviewNotes.level: The named defensive change is immediate. Legal captures and strongest replies do not require a deliberate sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game at ply 44, with exact source frame and preceding move, played e3. Archive https://theweekinchess.com/zips/twic1663g.zip; checksum 36ac4a1324a21674649f7b5eb12e0ef21167b18288917cce6aba3d8120669dd9.

reviews.reason: A safe king retreat is stronger than trying to block or exchange against a queen-and-rook mating battery.
reviews.distinctness: The king leaves the h-file mating net and can continue toward e7 if checked from h8.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi Kf8. Nếu Trắng vẫn chiếu Qh8+ thì Vua đen thoát qua e7. Trong ván đấu, Trắng chọn Bxb7 và Đen bắt lại bằng Rxb7.
hintsVi: Xe trắng trên h3 hỗ trợ Hậu chiếu ở h8. Hãy tìm đường cho Vua đen rời góc.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qh8# is legal if Black waits. Kf8 changes that check to Qh8+ and makes Ke7 available.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Bh4 is met by Qxh4. Pawn blocks g5 and g6 concede severe attacks, and passive rook moves leave Qh8#.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Bxb7 is strongest in the focused review and is met by Rxb7. Against Qxf7+ there is Qxf7. No king move leaves a newly viable piece offer.
reviewNotes.level: One king step solves the existing threat. No waiting or forced calculation is needed.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad Women 2026 game (2026.09.24) replayed through ply 41 and to the end. Rh3 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Kf8. Source SHA-256 87bcd88e628c85b6e7e5b36894738fc9e6ef4012345740e57ff05795a908940f.

reviews.reason: Remove the knight supporting the f2 mate, or castle to change the king’s exposure and permit a rook recapture.
reviews.distinctness: Compare a knight capture that also covers the mating square with kingside castling from the centre.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Nxe4, bắt Mã bảo vệ f2. Nếu Đen thử Qxf2+ thì Trắng đáp Nxf2. Trắng cũng có thể nhập thành gần bằng O-O. Khi đó Qxf2+ có thể được đáp bằng Rxf2.
hintsVi: Mã đen trên e4 bảo vệ f2. Trắng có thể bắt Mã đó hoặc đưa Vua khỏi trung tâm bằng cách nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The e4 knight protects f2, making Qxf2# possible. Nxe4 removes that guard and places a white knight on e4 to recapture on f2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: O-O is a verified alternative. Rf1 is viable but less active in the reviewed comparison, and Bxe4 allows more pressure after dxe4.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: dxe4, the strongest reply, exchanges the two knights with the pawn taking the white knight. Qxf2+ can be met by Nxf2. Qxe4 permits Bxe4.
reviewNotes.level: The first move immediately stops the threat without an unequal exchange.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.18) replayed through ply 24 and to the end. Qxf5 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Nxe4. Source SHA-256 36ac4a1324a21674649f7b5eb12e0ef21167b18288917cce6aba3d8120669dd9.

reviews.reason: Interpose a knight on the bishop’s support diagonal so the queen cannot mate on h7.
reviews.distinctness: Interpose a knight on the bishop’s support diagonal so the queen cannot mate on h7.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi Ng6 để cắt đường chéo d3–h7 của Tượng trắng. Nếu Hậu vẫn bắt trên h7, Vua đen có thể bắt lại. Nếu Tượng bắt Mã ở g6, Đen dùng Tốt bắt lại.
hintsVi: Tượng d3 đang bảo vệ ô h7 theo đường chéo nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Interpose a knight on the bishop’s support diagonal so the queen cannot mate on h7.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: ...g5 leaves Qxh7#. The quieter ...h6 is an additional verified move; it removes the h7 pawn and changes the king’s responses.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: f4 and Rae1 keep pressure. Bxg6 is answered by ...fxg6 or ...hxg6 and is an equal minor-piece exchange. Qxg6 loses the queen after either recapture.
reviewNotes.level: The named defensive change is immediate. Legal captures and strongest replies do not require a deliberate sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad Women 2026 game at ply 25, with exact source frame and preceding move, played Ng6. Archive https://theweekinchess.com/zips/twic1664g.zip; checksum 87bcd88e628c85b6e7e5b36894738fc9e6ef4012345740e57ff05795a908940f.

reviews.reason: The king sidesteps a discovered mate and turns the attempted checking capture into a recapturable bishop offer.
reviews.distinctness: Escape a discovered attack by recognizing the stationary queen behind the bishop.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Kg1 để rời cột h. Nếu Đen thử Bxf2+ thì Trắng có thể bắt lại bằng Nxf2. Khi Tượng rời h4, Hậu đen mở đường chiếu dọc cột h, nhưng Vua trắng đã thoát khỏi đường đó.
hintsVi: Nếu Tượng đen bắt f2, đường chiếu nào của Hậu đen sẽ mở ra?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bxf2# uncovers the black queen’s check along the h-file. Kg1 leaves that line and permits a capture on f2 after Bxf2+.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Ng3 is a defensible block but scores worse against the strongest review. Tempting Bxh6+ and Be5+ do not meet the attack safely.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: f6, g3 and Qf5 remain serious. After Bxf2+ the knight or king can take on f2. Rxc7 can be answered by Bxc7, with no material offer created by Kg1.
reviewNotes.level: A single king move meets the specific discovered mate and requires no countercombination.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.23) replayed through ply 68 and to the end. Qh5 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Kg1. Source SHA-256 87bcd88e628c85b6e7e5b36894738fc9e6ef4012345740e57ff05795a908940f.

reviews.reason: Capturing the attacking rook with the queen preserves the knight that protects d4, avoiding a second tactical loss.
reviews.distinctness: Select the correct capturer rather than treating all captures of the mating rook as equivalent.
reviews.solutionVi: Trong phương án luyện tập, Đen đi Qxc7 để bắt Xe và giữ Mã trên e6. Trong ván đấu, Đen đi Nxc7. Khi đó Trắng có thể chiếu Qh8+, rồi Nxf7+ và bắt Hậu trên d6.
hintsVi: Xe trắng ở c7 dọa Rxf7#. Đen có hai quân bắt được Xe. Hãy xem điều gì xảy ra nếu Mã rời e6.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rxf7# is available after passive moves. Qxc7 removes the rook and retains the knight on e6.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: The played Nxc7 also stops the immediate mate. Qh8+ Kxh8 Nxf7+ Kg7 Nxd6 is an analyzed refutation of treating it as equivalent.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After Qxc7, Nd3 and Nc6 are stronger than sacrificial checks. Qh8+ or Qg8+ can be met by a king capture; Qf8+ allows Nxf8. Nxf7 and Nxg6 can be recaptured.
reviewNotes.level: One capture solves the threat without requiring the comparison line to be played in practice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad Women 2026 game (2026.09.18) replayed through ply 67 and to the end. Rxc7 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Nxc7. Source SHA-256 36ac4a1324a21674649f7b5eb12e0ef21167b18288917cce6aba3d8120669dd9.

reviews.reason: Move the threatened rook while keeping e1 covered and attacking the mating queen.
reviews.distinctness: A rook escape on the same rank, with a bishop protecting the destination and a direct attack on the queen.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Rd1. Xe vẫn giữ e1 và tấn công Hậu trên d2. Nếu Đen bắt Xe bằng Qxd1+ thì Tượng trắng từ f3 bắt lại bằng Bxd1.
hintsVi: Xe trắng đang bị Hậu đen nhắm tới. Hãy tìm ô để Xe vẫn giữ e1 và đồng thời tấn công Hậu.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qxe1# is legal after a queen move that overlooks e1. Rd1 removes the target, covers e1, and attacks Qd2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Rb1, Ra1 and Rf1 can cover e1 but do not attack the queen. Rxe6+ offers the rook for a materially worse defence.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qc3 and Qxc2 are strongest. Qxc2 takes a pawn that was already attacked from d2, not a new rook or defender offer. Qxd1+ Bxd1 trades the attacker’s queen for the rook; Qe1+ allows Rxe1.
reviewNotes.level: The one-move counterattack is a direct defensive response with no real sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.19) replayed through ply 78 and to the end. Qd2 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Rd1. Source SHA-256 36ac4a1324a21674649f7b5eb12e0ef21167b18288917cce6aba3d8120669dd9.

reviews.reason: The pawn chooses the correct diagonal block because the other apparent block can be removed immediately.
reviews.distinctness: Contrasts ...g6 with ...f5 on the same diagonal, where White can remove the f5 pawn at once.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi g6, chặn đường Hậu trắng đến h7. Nếu Qxg6+ thì Đen có thể bắt lại bằng hxg6. Sau f5, Trắng có nước exf6 để gỡ chốt chặn.
hintsVi: Hậu trắng nhắm h7 theo đường chéo. Nếu Đen đi f5 để chặn, Tốt trắng trên e5 có thể đáp thế nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The bishop on d3 protects h7 and the queen on e4 can deliver Qxh7#. ...g6 interrupts e4–f5–g6–h7.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: After ...f5 White can play exf6 and restore access to h7. ...Nf6 likewise allows exf6. Rook moves leave the direct mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qe3 and a4 are the strongest replies. Qxg6+ is met by hxg6 or fxg6. Qxa8 allows Rxa8, and other captures can be recaptured.
reviewNotes.level: A one-move pawn block whose apparent substitute has an immediate tactical drawback.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.23) replayed through ply 33 and to the end. Qxe4 reaches the exercise; the next played move is g6. Source SHA-256 87bcd88e628c85b6e7e5b36894738fc9e6ef4012345740e57ff05795a908940f.

reviews.reason: A countercheck doubles as lasting protection of g2 and gains time against the attacking queen.
reviews.distinctness: The checking queen covers g2 itself, so the defence does not rely on a repeated check.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Qf3+. Hậu chiếu Vua đen trên a8 theo đường chéo và đồng thời giữ g2. Trong ván đấu, Đen đáp Kb8.
hintsVi: Trắng có thể chiếu Vua đen và đồng thời bảo vệ g2 bằng nước Hậu nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: After a passive move Qxg2# is legal. Qf3+ both checks along the diagonal to a8 and controls g2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Rf2 and g3 also defend, but give Black the initiative and lower the tested advantage. A countercheck without coverage is not the teaching choice.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kb8 is strongest. Qe4 and Qc6 block the check but let White capture the queen. No capture of the white queen or a stationary defender is available at once.
reviewNotes.level: A single move both meets the threat and creates a forcing reply, with no offer or prolonged forcing line required.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Fagernes GM Swiss Aut game (2026.10.03) replayed through ply 80 and to the end. Qc2 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Qf3+. Source SHA-256 302fde627aaacdc30bf276442347ff0f73cbae00914416d71f68c6d4243dd2b4.

reviews.reason: A guarded queen on f7 both protects g7 and offers a sound exchange of queens.
reviews.distinctness: Defend a mating square through an adjacent equal trade and recognize the complete recapture sequence.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi Qf7 để giữ g7. Nếu Trắng đổi Hậu bằng Qxf7+ thì Vua đen bắt lại. Trong ván đấu, Trắng đi Qxg7+, Đen đáp Qxg7, rồi Bxg7 Kxg7.
hintsVi: Tìm ô để Hậu đen vừa bảo vệ g7 vừa được Vua đen bảo vệ.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qxg7# is available after passive moves. Qf7 allows Qxg7+ Qxg7 Bxg7 Kxg7.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qg5 also looks like a queen trade, but Qxg5 hxg5 Re7 leaves a much stronger attack. Qxg2+ gives White the better position.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxf7+ is met by Kxf7, an even exchange. Qg3, Qg4 and the active Re6 are similarly sound replies to Qf7. No genuine sacrifice is needed.
reviewNotes.level: Defence is established by Qf7. Recaptures illustrate the equal exchange.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad Women 2026 game (2026.09.21) replayed through ply 53 and to the end. Qxg6 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Qf7. Source SHA-256 36ac4a1324a21674649f7b5eb12e0ef21167b18288917cce6aba3d8120669dd9.

reviews.reason: Capturing the supporting bishop both removes its control and opens the mating square to the king’s recapture.
reviews.distinctness: A pawn vacates the mating square as it captures the bishop controlling it.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi gxf3, bắt Tượng đang khống chế g2. Nếu Đen vẫn đi Qg2+ thì Trắng đáp Kxg2.
hintsVi: Quân nào của Đen bảo vệ g2? Nếu Tốt trắng bắt quân đó, Vua trắng có thể làm gì khi Hậu đen chiếu ở g2?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bishop f3 supports Qxg2#. After gxf3 the f3 bishop is gone and Qg2+ allows Kxg2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qf1 and Qg1 add a guard but leave the bishop in play. Rg4 allows Bxg4. An unrelated rook move leaves the exact mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qf6 is strongest and the actual Qc4 keeps play contested. Qg2+ and Qg1+ allow captures. Black has no immediate legal capture after the solution.
reviewNotes.level: A direct recapture removes the attacking support at once.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.21) replayed through ply 80 and to the end. Bxf3 reaches the exercise; the next played move is gxf3. Source SHA-256 36ac4a1324a21674649f7b5eb12e0ef21167b18288917cce6aba3d8120669dd9.

reviews.reason: A knight blocks the queen’s route to f7, while the verified castling alternative preserves the lesson’s special-move coverage.
reviews.distinctness: Interposition on the f-file versus castling to remove the king and bring the rook to the f-file.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi Nf6, đặt Mã giữa Hậu trắng và f7. Nếu Qxf6 thì gxf6 bắt lại Hậu. Đen cũng có thể nhập thành gần bằng O-O.
hintsVi: Hậu trắng đi từ f5 đến f7 theo đường nào? Đen có thể chặn đường đó hoặc đưa Vua đi đâu?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qxf7# is legal after a passive move. Nf6 closes the f-file in front of the queen. Castling also stops the mate.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: O-O is fully reviewed and accepted. Bf6 blocks the line but allows more pressure with Bh5, while Rf8 lets White take f7 with the knight.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Rf4 and d5 are strong continuations. Qxf6 gives up the queen to gxf6 or Bxf6. Nxf7 allows Kxf7. The stationary h4 pawn can be recaptured by Rxh4.
reviewNotes.level: Both the knight block and castling are one-move defences. Neither requires a material offer.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.16) replayed through ply 35 and to the end. Qxf5 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Nf6. Source SHA-256 36ac4a1324a21674649f7b5eb12e0ef21167b18288917cce6aba3d8120669dd9.

reviews.reason: Use the bishop from d1 to remove the knight guarding the mating entry on h2.
reviews.distinctness: Use the bishop from d1 to remove the knight guarding the mating entry on h2.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Bxg4, bắt Mã đang bảo vệ h2. Nếu Đen vẫn bắt Qxh2+, Vua trắng có thể bắt Hậu. Đen có thể dùng Tượng d7 bắt lại ở g4.
hintsVi: Hãy tìm quân đen đang bảo vệ ô h2.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Use the bishop from d1 to remove the knight guarding the mating entry on h2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Tempting queen moves such as Qg5 allow ...Qxh2#. The candidate Nf3 ranks clearly worse even though it changes the immediate threat.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: ...Bxg4 trades bishop for knight and is Black’s strongest reply. If ...Qxh2+ first, Kxh2 is legal.
reviewNotes.level: The named defensive change is immediate. Legal captures and strongest replies do not require a deliberate sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game at ply 62, with exact source frame and preceding move, played Bxg4. Archive https://theweekinchess.com/zips/twic1663g.zip; checksum 36ac4a1324a21674649f7b5eb12e0ef21167b18288917cce6aba3d8120669dd9.

reviews.reason: Countercheck with the second rook while the first rook is the mating target.
reviews.distinctness: Countercheck with the second rook while the first rook is the mating target.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi Rb1+, giành lượt tấn công trước khi Trắng kịp bắt Xe ở f8 chiếu hết. Nếu Vua trắng đến g2, Đen tiếp tục chiếu bằng Qh3+.
hintsVi: Xe đen nào có thể chiếu Vua trắng ngay?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Countercheck with the second rook while the first rook is the mating target.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: ...Qxf4 and ...Rxf2 miss the defensive countercheck and have much worse assessments. ...Re8 changes the mating move to Rxe8#.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kg2 is the strongest sample reply, after which ...Qh3+ sustains the initiative. Interpositions Qd1 and Re1 can be captured; Kh2 permits ...Qh3# in one.
reviewNotes.level: The named defensive change is immediate. Legal captures and strongest replies do not require a deliberate sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 4th Amsterdam Chess Open game at ply 55, with exact source frame and preceding move, played Rb1+. Archive https://theweekinchess.com/zips/twic1668g.zip; checksum d455919e2736370933e89e106c114a348807cc26acae4bd4b9b78ade35bcdf4e.

reviews.reason: Drop the queen to the back rank, or give the king an escape square, to stop the same queen entry.
reviews.distinctness: Long diagonal queen retreat to cover e1 versus the alternate pawn move opening g2 for the king.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Qd1 để nếu Đen chiếu Qe1+ thì đáp Qxe1. Trắng cũng có thể đi g3, mở ô g2 cho Vua thoát khi Đen chiếu từ e1.
hintsVi: Đen dọa Qe1#. Hãy tìm cách giữ e1 hoặc mở ô thoát cho Vua trắng.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qe1# is legal if White leaves the back rank unguarded. Qd1 lets White answer Qe1+ with Qxe1.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: g3 is a verified alternative and creates Kg2 after Qe1+. g4 and Kf1 are weaker. Counterchecking with Qxh6+ allows gxh6 and a worse position.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qd5, Bc7 and several quiet replies leave play even in the reviewed lines. Bxb4 is recapturable by cxb4, Qxd4 by Qxd4, and Qxg2+ by Kxg2.
reviewNotes.level: Direct A back-rank defence with both the guard and flight-square methods represented.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.17) replayed through ply 50 and to the end. Bd6 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Qd1. Source SHA-256 36ac4a1324a21674649f7b5eb12e0ef21167b18288917cce6aba3d8120669dd9.

reviews.reason: Advance the targeted pawn itself to cut the queen’s path, with a bishop guard as a distinct verified alternative.
reviews.distinctness: Evacuate the pawn on the mating square and block the attacking queen on the same file. The bishop alternative defends from a diagonal.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi h6 để chặn đường Hậu đến h7. Nếu Trắng bắt bằng Qxh6 thì Đen đáp gxh6. Đen cũng có thể đi Bd3 để bảo vệ h7 bằng Tượng.
hintsVi: Tốt h7 đang là mục tiêu. Có thể đưa Tốt đi một ô để chặn luôn đường Hậu trắng không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qxh7# is legal after a passive move. ...h6 occupies the queen’s approach square with a defended pawn.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: ...Bd3 is also verified and directly covers h7. ...Nf6 allows exf6. The rook moves leave White with a dangerous attacking continuation.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Ne4 and Be4 are strong. Qxh6 is met by gxh6. Qxf7+ and Nxf7 both allow Rxf7. Bxd5 can be answered by Rxd5.
reviewNotes.level: One direct pawn move meets the mate. The alternate bishop move is also a one-move guard.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.21) replayed through ply 39 and to the end. Nxg5 reaches the exercise; the next played move is h6. Source SHA-256 36ac4a1324a21674649f7b5eb12e0ef21167b18288917cce6aba3d8120669dd9.

reviews.reason: The queen removes the support pawn and keeps the bishop beside the king, ready for a second mating entry.
reviews.distinctness: Capture a pawn supporter with the right piece while preserving the g2 bishop’s defensive job on h1.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Qxf3. Hậu trắng bắt Tốt đang bảo vệ g2 và tự khống chế ô này. Tượng trắng vẫn giữ h1. Nếu Đen chiếu Qh1+ thì Trắng có thể đáp Bxh1.
hintsVi: Tốt f3 đang hỗ trợ Hậu đen tấn công g2. Trắng có thể bắt Tốt ấy mà vẫn giữ Tượng trên g2 bằng nước nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qxg2# is legal because f3 supports g2. Qxf3 removes that pawn and guards g2 while Bg2 still covers h1.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Bxf3 also removes the pawn, but Rf5 is stronger when White’s bishop has left g2. The countercheck Nb6+ delays the defence and allows a stronger attack.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Rf5 is best in the reviewed line and is met by Qh3. Qxg2+ can be captured by king or queen, and Qh1+ by Bxh1. No new viable offer is created.
reviewNotes.level: The opening decision is a direct capture. The choice of capturer makes it distinct from the pawn recapture on f3.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.18) replayed through ply 40 and to the end. f3 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Qxf3. Source SHA-256 36ac4a1324a21674649f7b5eb12e0ef21167b18288917cce6aba3d8120669dd9.

reviews.reason: A long-range rook guard answers a mate at the far end of the seventh rank, with an equivalent queen guard.
reviews.distinctness: Rank defence by lifting the rook from a8, contrasted with the actual-game queen route to b7.
reviews.solutionVi: Trong phương án luyện tập, Đen đi Ra7 để có thể đáp Qxg7+ bằng Rxg7. Trong ván đấu, Đen đi Qb7, cũng bảo vệ g7 dọc theo hàng 7.
hintsVi: Có thể dùng hàng 7 để bảo vệ g7 từ xa. Hãy xem cả Xe và Hậu đen.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qxg7# is legal after a passive move. After Ra7 the rook can capture on g7 if either the queen or the supporting bishop takes there.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qb7 reaches g7 along the same rank and is a verified alternative. Kf8 and Qg4 lead to worse practical positions.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: a5, Be3 and Bd2 are strong ways to continue attacking. Bxg7 or Qxg7+ permits Rxg7. Checks Qe8+ and Qh7+ leave a reply. No viable material offer.
reviewNotes.level: A direct guard, despite the distance the rook covers. Both first moves are accepted and the source move is identified.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.26) replayed through ply 65 and to the end. Bh6 reaches the exercise; the next played move is Qb7. Source SHA-256 87bcd88e628c85b6e7e5b36894738fc9e6ef4012345740e57ff05795a908940f.

reviews.reason: An equal bishop-for-knight exchange removes the support on f2 and allows a king recapture against a renewed mate threat.
reviews.distinctness: Equal exchange followed by a king capture of the dangerous pawn on f2.
reviews.solutionVi: Bxf2 lấy Mã. Nếu Đen vẫn chơi Qh1+, Trắng có Bg1. Sau gxf2, Đen lại dọa Qg1#. Kxf2 bắt Tốt và đưa Vua ra khỏi hàng ngang cuối.
hintsVi: Đen dọa Qh1#. Hãy bắt quân đang khống chế f2 và tính cách đáp khi Tốt g3 bắt lại.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bxf2 opens Bg1 against Qh1+ and eliminates the knight supporting the net.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Bf3 permits Nxd1 and Bxh5+ allows Rxh5. Once the g-pawn reaches f2, Bf3 also allows fxe1=R+.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Both captures of the bishop and the knight were reviewed. gxf2 Kxf2 exchanges minor pieces and wins the pawn. After Kxf2 Qxg2+ allows Kxg2. Rag8 and Bh3 are the strongest reviewed continuations.
reviewNotes.level: Two defensive decisions. Equal initial exchange followed by a king recapture.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete chess.com Speed 2020 game (2020.11.11) to source ply 52 and independently matched the FEN, previous move and stable game hash. Verified archive checksum metadata and master evidence. The game follows the teaching line through both solver moves.

reviews.reason: First offer an equal queen exchange to address g7, then use the h-pawn to defend against a new threat on h7 after the exchange is declined.
reviews.distinctness: First offer an equal queen exchange to address g7, then use the h-pawn to defend against a new threat on h7 after the exchange is declined.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi Qg5 để chặn đường Hậu trắng đến g7 và đề nghị đổi Hậu. Trong phương án Qh3, Trắng chuyển sang dọa bắt ở h7 chiếu hết. Đen đi h5. Nếu Trắng bắt Qxh5, Hậu đen bắt lại.
hintsVi: Sau khi Hậu trắng rời g4 sang h3, ô chiếu hết thay đổi thế nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: First offer an equal queen exchange to address g7, then use the h-pawn to defend against a new threat on h7 after the exchange is declined.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: ...g6 also defends at the start. After Qh3 the threat shifts to h7, and ...h6 allows Qh7#. ...g6 and ...Qh4 also meet the renewed threat.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qh3 and Qxg5 are the most challenging replies. ...Bxg5 restores material after the exchange. If Qxh5 after ...h5, ...Qxh5 wins the queen.
reviewNotes.level: Two relevant decisions withstand a strong reply. Relevant captures either trade equal material or lose to a recapture.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Titled Tue 14th Mar Late game at ply 29, with exact source frame and preceding move. Archive https://www.pgnmentor.com/players/Kramnik.zip; checksum c6f5896f5495b7d99c86f33f83f47f95e09ac8b2296f3ed94ecb2e45f0099f28.

reviews.reason: White switches defensive pieces when Black switches mating squares from g2 to h1.
reviews.distinctness: A queen shield on g3 followed by a long rook retreat to cover the first rank.
reviews.solutionVi: Trong phương án minh họa, Qg3 chặn đường Hậu Đen đến g2. Sau Qe4, Đen chuyển sang dọa Qh1#. Ra1 đưa Xe về hàng ngang cuối để có thể bắt Hậu trên h1.
hintsVi: Đen dọa Qg2#. Sau khi Hậu Trắng chặn đường, hãy kiểm tra mối đe dọa mới nếu Hậu Đen chuyển sang e4.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qg3 blocks the g-file and is defended by f2. Qe4 switches the threat to h1 and Ra1 controls that square.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: f3 leaves Black with a strong Qd3. Qg4 is another sound initial shield and was played. After Qe4, Qg5 allows Qh1+ and Rf3+.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qe4 is close to the strongest Qd3. Black can exchange queens after Qg3, when fxg3 recaptures. After Ra1, Rxf2+ allows Bxf2 and Qxe3 allows Qxe3.
reviewNotes.level: Two quiet defensive moves by different pieces, switching from a file block to a rank guard.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.27) to source ply 68 and independently matched the FEN, previous move and stable game hash. Verified archive checksum metadata and master evidence. The saved solution is a teaching variation.

reviews.reason: Queen placement stops the immediate mate, then a knight captures the checking knight rather than allowing a king move to expose the queen to a fork.
reviews.distinctness: Guard the mating square and meet a check-and-fork with an equal knight trade.
reviews.solutionVi: Qxg4 kiểm soát g7. Sau Nf6+, Mã Trắng vừa chiếu Vua vừa tấn công Hậu g4. Đen đáp Nxf6 để loại Mã đang chiếu. Nếu Trắng bắt lại bằng Qxf6, Đen có Qg6 để tiếp tục phòng thủ.
hintsVi: Hãy tìm một nước Hậu giữ được g7. Nếu Mã Trắng chiếu từ f6, kiểm tra xem Mã đó còn tấn công quân nào.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qxg4 controls g7, denying mate. Nf6+ forks the king and queen, so taking with the other knight removes both threats.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Ne6 is viable but requires a different structure. After Nf6+, Kh8 and Kg7 allow Nxg4+. Nxf6 is the unique viable reviewed reply to that check.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Nf6+ is the strongest response, with Qc2+ and Nf4 close. Qxf6 is strongest after Nxf6, restoring equal material in the knight exchange. Qg6 holds against the next checks.
reviewNotes.level: The second choice solves a concrete fork produced by the first defence. The knight exchange is even.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete 3rd Norway Chess 2015 game (2015.06.21) to source ply 73 and matched the FEN, previous move and game hash. Checked the archive checksum metadata and master evidence. The game follows the teaching line through both solver moves.

reviews.reason: The king removes the bishop that supports mate and then the f-pawn blocks check with a direct threat to the queen.
reviews.distinctness: Capture the mating-square guard with the king, then use a supported pawn interposition to save a loose bishop.
reviews.solutionVi: Kxg2 bắt Tượng đang bảo vệ h1. Trong phương án minh họa, sau Qe4+ Trắng đáp f3, vừa chắn đường chiếu vừa tấn công Hậu Đen. Nếu chỉ tránh chiếu bằng Kg1, Đen có Nxf6 bắt Tượng.
hintsVi: Quân nào bảo vệ h1 cho Hậu Đen? Sau khi Vua bắt quân đó, hãy tìm nước chắn nếu Hậu Đen chiếu từ e4.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The g2 bishop supports Qh1 mate. Its removal makes h1 safe, and f3 intercepts the new diagonal check while threatening Qe4.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Be5+ and Bd8+ are inferior initial checks. After Qe4+, all king retreats allow Nxf6. The interposition protects against that by attacking the queen.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qe4+ is comparable to Qf5 and Qg6. Nxf6 after f3 gives up the queen to fxe4, and Qxf3+ allows Kxf3. After f3 Qg6 and Qb1 are stronger replies.
reviewNotes.level: Two distinct decisions, a king capture and a supported pawn block with tempo. No offer is needed.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete Carlsen Tour Final 2020 game (2020.08.15) to source ply 76 and matched the FEN, previous move and game hash. Checked the archive checksum metadata and master evidence. The saved solution is a teaching variation.

reviews.reason: An intermediate queen check draws the bishop away from g2 before the black king moves to e8.
reviews.distinctness: Deflect a bishop by checking before relocating the king and arranging knight interposition.
reviews.solutionVi: Qd1+ Bf1 kéo Tượng khỏi đường chéo g2–c6. Bây giờ Đen có thể chơi Ke8. Nếu Trắng chiếu Qa8+, Đen có Nd8 để chắn. Đi Ke8 ngay thì sau Qa8+ Nd8, Trắng còn Bc6+.
hintsVi: Thử chiếu từ d1. Nếu Tượng trắng về f1 để chắn, Vua đen có thêm cách tránh đòn tấn công nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The checking tempo relocates the bishop, removing Bc6+ after Qa8+ Nd8.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Direct Ke8 lets White play Qa8+ followed by Bc6+ against Nd8 or Rb8 against Qd8. Nc7 is a viable alternative with its own reply to Rb8+.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Both queen and bishop interpositions on f1 were checked. Qf1 can be met by Qxf1+ and a queen exchange. After Bf1 Ke8, the exact Qa8+ Nd8 board leaves no Bc6+; Qc6+ can be met by Kf8.

reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: exd5 is the strongest reply and trades equal minor pieces. After Qxd5, Nf6 and h6 are strongest. The two captures on g2 both allow Qxg2, and against Qxg2+ White can eventually recapture the rook with Kxg2.
reviewNotes.level: An equal exchange requires a second defender to take over the same critical diagonal. Both are necessary in the chosen order.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.19) to source ply 42 and matched the FEN, previous move and game hash. Checked the archive checksum metadata and master evidence. The game follows the teaching line through both solver moves.

reviews.reason: A rook captures the supporter of mate on g2, then returns to f1 to block a separate rook check.
reviews.distinctness: Rook shuttle from f1 to f2 and back, with an equal second exchange that the king can complete.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxf2 loại Xe đang hỗ trợ Qg2#. Trong phương án minh họa, Đen chiếu Rc1+ và Trắng đưa Xe về f1 để chắn. Nếu Đen đổi Xe bằng Rxf1+, Trắng bắt lại bằng Kxf1. Kh2 để Đen chiếu hết ngay trên h1.
hintsVi: Tìm Xe Đen đang hỗ trợ đòn Qg2#. Sau khi bắt Xe đó, tính cách chắn nếu Xe còn lại chiếu từ c1.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rxf2 removes g2 support. Rc1+ changes to a back-rank attack. Rf1 blocks the rook line and the king backs the block.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: After Rc1+, Kh2 allows Qh1# or Rh1#. The initial Qb8+ is also viable with Rxf2 as a follow-up.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qd1+ is also strong after Rxf2 and was played, with Kg2 in the game. In the sample Rxf1+ Kxf1 exchanges rooks equally. The opposing queen still has checks, so the solution only claims survival of the attack.
reviewNotes.level: A capture and a return by the same rook coordinate against threats on two lines. No sacrifice is required.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game (2026.09.26) to source ply 68 and independently matched the FEN, previous move and stable game hash. Verified archive checksum metadata and master evidence. The saved solution is a teaching variation.

reviews.reason: A pawn interposes on a bishop diagonal and buys time for a knight to guard the mating square.
reviews.distinctness: Pawn interposition temporarily breaks the mating battery, followed by direct reinforcement of h7.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qxh7# nhờ Tượng d3 bảo vệ h7. Đen chơi ...f5, chặn đường chéo của Tượng. Sau Qxf5, ...Nf6 bảo vệ h7. Nếu Trắng bắt Tốt bằng Bxf5, Đen vẫn có thể chơi ...Nf6.
hintsVi: Lần theo đường chéo từ Tượng d3 đến h7.
Tìm cách chặn đường chéo ngay, rồi đưa Mã đến ô bảo vệ h7.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White threatens Qxh7# with the bishop on d3 guarding h7. f5 breaks the d3–h7 diagonal immediately. Qxf5 vacates the original square and renews the threat on h7.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Kh8 and Ne5 both permit Qxh7#. h6 or g6 stop that exact move but lose the bishop on d5 and leave an inferior position. After Qxf5, the legal root comparison singles out Nf6.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Both Qxf5 and Bxf5 are credible acceptances and cost one pawn with no immediate recapture. Nf6 holds h7 after either capture. The queen capture at f6 loses to gxf6. White can retain pressure with Bh6, which the review checks with Qc8.
reviewNotes.level: A simple pawn sacrifice with two concrete Black decisions and roughly equal material after acceptance.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete 46th Olympiad 2026 game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 29 and previous move Qh5. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation f5 Qxf5 Nf6 with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: A bishop sacrifice diverts the queen and lets the solver pin it on the king diagonal.
reviews.distinctness: Lure the mating queen onto e6 with a checking bishop sacrifice and pin the relocated queen.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qh2#. Trắng chiếu Bxe6+ để kéo Hậu đen khỏi h3. Sau ...Qxe6, Qc4 ghim Hậu e6 vào Vua g8. Nếu ...Qd5, Trắng có thể đổi Hậu bằng Qxd5+ cxd5.
hintsVi: Có thể chiếu để kéo Hậu đen rời h3 bằng quân nào?
Sau khi Hậu đen đến e6, hãy nhìn đường chéo c4–g8.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The queen on h3 threatens Qh2#. Bxe6+ draws it to e6 in the strongest reply. Qc4 then attacks the queen on the c4–g8 diagonal with the Black king behind it.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Quiet rook or bishop moves commonly allow Qh2#. Direct pawn defence f3 or f4 allows an en passant or ordinary e-pawn capture and leaves an inferior position. After Qxe6, the alternatives f3 and f4 are again much weaker than Qc4.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxe6 is a genuine acceptance with a bishop for one pawn and no immediate recapture. Kh8 and Rf7 give up the queen at h3 to Bxh3. After Qc4, both Rae8 and Qd5 were checked; Qd5 allows Qxd5+ cxd5.
reviewNotes.level: A single sacrifice of bishop for pawn from 130 cp up to 100 cp down, followed by a pin with a rook-protected queen.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete 46th Olympiad Women 2026 game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 44 and previous move Qxh3. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Bxe6+ Qxe6 Qc4 with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: The knight interposes on the h-file at real material cost, and the pawn advance removes a second entry for the attack.
reviews.distinctness: An interposed knight is deliberately offered to a pawn that supports the mating attack, creating a new pawn structure around the king.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi Nh6, thí Mã để chặn cột h. Sau gxh6, phương án luyện tập là g5, đưa Tốt g7 khỏi tầm bắt của Tốt trắng. Nếu Trắng chiếu h7+ thì Vua đen về h8. Trong ván đấu, Đen chọn Qxe5 để Hậu giữ g7.
hintsVi: Đen cần chặn cột h. Nếu Tốt trắng bắt quân chặn rồi đứng ở h6, Đen sẽ xử lý Tốt g7 thế nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qh8# is legal if Black waits. Nh6 stops it by blocking the h-file. White can accept the knight with the g-pawn, moving it off g5.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qxa2+ gives up the queen with no viable continuation. The quiet h-file or g-file attempts f6 and f5 still allow a crushing attack after Qh8+.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxh6 is met by gxh6, winning the queen. White’s gxh6 acceptance costs Black a knight, or a knight for a pawn if immediately recaptured. After the reviewed g5, h7+ is met by Kh8 and Qxe6 by Bxe6. Qxe5 was played and is a verified alternate after gxh6.
reviewNotes.level: The C distinction is the single knight sacrifice to interrupt the h-file. Black’s initial material edge does not save a routine move against the concrete mate.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Hoogovens game (1998.01.27) replayed through ply 39 and to the end. Qh3 reaches the exercise. The played continuation is Nh6 gxh6 Qxe5. Source SHA-256 9f7227690c26ed05688cf1c118c46585c8d6a69a054764f5ef2649c47aeb292f.

reviews.reason: A checking exchange sacrifice removes the shared bishop guard behind two mate threats and draws the queen away.
reviews.distinctness: Capture the shared bishop guard with check, compare queen, king and pawn recaptures, then turn the queen on a rook.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa cả Qg2# lẫn Qh1# nhờ Tượng c6. Trắng thí chất bằng Rxc6+ để loại Tượng. Sau ...Qxc6, Qf5 tấn công Xe c8. Nếu Hậu đen vẫn chiếu ở g2 hoặc h1, Vua trắng có thể bắt Hậu.
hintsVi: Hai nước chiếu hết của Đen cùng dựa vào quân nào?
Xét nước bắt quân có chiếu và ô để Hậu trắng tấn công Xe c8.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: With the bishop on c6, Black has Qg2# and Qh1#. Rxc6+ removes the common guard and the sample recapture Qxc6 moves the attacking queen off e4.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qxf4 stops only one of the two mates and permits Qg2#. Bd8+ changes the move order but is inferior after Kb8. King or pawn acceptance of the sacrifice exposes the Black king to strong counterplay.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxc6 is the strongest acceptance and leaves White 70 cp down from a 100 cp initial lead. Qf5 attacks c8 and holds against Re8. The former mating checks Qg2+ and Qh1+ both lose the queen to the White king.
reviewNotes.level: One exchange sacrifice and an active second White move. The live tension is between the two mating threats and the endangered Black rook.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete Fagernes GM Swiss Aut game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 66 and previous move Kc7. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Rxc6+ Qxc6 Qf5 with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: A queen sacrifice removes the mating-square guard before promotion restores the queen.
reviews.distinctness: Choose the order of queen sacrifice and promotion. This is the only defence in the reviewed C packets with promotion as the immediate material recovery.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qh8# nhờ Tượng d4. Nếu Đen phong cấp ngay, Trắng vẫn chiếu hết. Đen chơi ...Qxd4 trước để loại Tượng. Sau Qxd4, ...b1=Q đưa Hậu mới vào bàn cờ.
hintsVi: Kiểm tra đe dọa của Trắng nếu Đen phong cấp ngay.
Tìm quân bảo vệ h8 rồi quyết định thứ tự hai nước.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The bishop on d4 guards h8 along the diagonal. Promoting first with b1=Q allows Qh8#. Qxd4 removes the guard and draws the White queen off the mating diagonal in the strongest acceptance.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: The tempting immediate promotion is refuted by exact mate in one. Bg7 instead allows Qxg7#. The all-root comparison finds Qxd4 viable, and promotion to a rook after acceptance is much weaker.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxd4 accepts the queen for a bishop, changing equal material to a 570 cp deficit. b1=Q then recovers the queen and changes that to a 230 cp edge. Declines such as f4 and Qe8 leave stronger Black continuations. After promotion, the checked h4 and Qd5 preserve the gain.
reviewNotes.level: Two Black moves, a clear single queen sacrifice, and an immediate legal promotion with meaningful move order.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete World Cup game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 75 and previous move Bd4. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Qxd4 Qxd4 b1=Q with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: A checking exchange sacrifice diverts the queen before a rook removes a pawn and takes over its return square.
reviews.distinctness: Divert the queen to d7 before playing Rxh4, the same capture that fails if played immediately. The second decision secures g4 instead of hunting the king.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qxg2# với Xe b2 bảo vệ g2. Trắng chiếu Rxd7+ để kéo Hậu khỏi g4. Sau ...Qxd7, Rxh4 bắt lại một Tốt và khống chế g4. Nếu Đen chiếu ...Rb1+, Trắng có thể đi Kh2.
hintsVi: Thử tính Rxh4 ngay. Hậu đen có nước chiếu hết nào?
Tìm nước chiếu kéo Hậu đen rời g4 trước khi bắt Tốt h4.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Black threatens Qxg2# with support from Rb2. Rxd7+ removes a bishop and draws the queen to d7 in the strongest reply. Rxh4 recovers a pawn and takes control of g4.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Immediate Rxh4 is refuted by Qxg2#. Rg5+ is a much weaker check, and other queen checks allow stronger defences. After Qxd7, Qa6 allows Rxg2+ and preserves more of Black’s pressure.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxd7 wins the exchange, moving White from 30 cp down to 200 cp down. Rxh4 regains a pawn. Kf6 and Kg6 are weaker declines because the White queen keeps strong checks. Rb1+ is still legal after the sample and can be met by Kh2.
reviewNotes.level: Two White moves with an accepted rook-for-bishop sacrifice. The second move shows precise timing and partial material recovery.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete 2nd 3-0 Thu 27th Aug 2026 game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 70 and previous move Kg7. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Rxd7+ Qxd7 Rxh4 with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: A rook sacrifice draws the queen onto a file where a discovered pin prevents the very mating move it still threatens.
reviews.distinctness: Lure the queen to b2, then clear the b-file with Nd5 to pin it to the king. The quiet second move forbids mate by legality, rather than merely stopping it by check.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qh8#. Đen thí Xe bằng ...Rxb2+ để kéo Hậu trắng đến b2. Sau Qxb2, ...Nd5 mở cột b. Hậu đen ở b8 ghim Hậu b2 vào Vua b1, nên Hậu trắng không thể đi Qh8.
hintsVi: Sau khi Hậu trắng đến b2, nhìn dọc cột b.
Dời quân đang chắn cột b để giữ Hậu trắng trước Vua.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White threatens Qh8# from f6. Rxb2+ draws the queen to b2. Qh8# is still a threat from b2 until Nd5 clears b6, opening the b8–b1 line and pinning the queen.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Quiet rook moves before and after acceptance allow immediate mate. Kxb2 is a legal but inferior acceptance because Nd5+ attacks the king and threatens Nxf6. After Qxb2, Nd5 is the viable root.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxb2 accepts a rook for a pawn, moving Black from 360 cp up to 40 cp down. Rxd5 attacks the newly moved knight, but Black can play Qxb2+ and trade queens. Qxb8 is a different defence checked with Rxb8+.
reviewNotes.level: Two Black moves with one rook sacrifice. Nd5 offers no additional sacrifice against Rxd5 because immediate equal-or-better recaptures exist. The sample prioritizes removing the pinned attacker.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete Sparkassen Gp 1 game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 41 and previous move Qxf6. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Rxb2+ Qxb2 Nd5 with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: A queen sacrifice removes the rook attacking it before the king captures the piece that cages it.
reviews.distinctness: Compare the order of a queen-for-rook sacrifice and the capture on g1. Directly opening the king escape lets the opponent win the queen without giving up the rook.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qh2# nhờ Tượng g1. Nếu bắt Tượng ngay, Trắng mất Hậu sau ...Rxa5. Trắng chơi Qxe5+ trước để lấy Xe. Sau ...dxe5, Kxg1 loại Tượng bảo vệ h2.
hintsVi: Bắt Tượng g1 ngay sẽ để hở quân trắng nào?
Xét nước bắt Xe có chiếu trước khi giải nguy ở g1.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Black threatens Qh2#. The bishop on g1 covers h2 and occupies a potential king escape square. Removing it can neutralize the mate, but doing so first leaves the queen on a5 to Rxa5.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Kxg1 and Rxg1 both stop the immediate mate but allow Rxa5. A focused 1.2M-node review confirms Rxa5 after Kxg1. Qxe5+ removes the rook before White takes the bishop.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: dxe5 accepts a queen for a rook, changing White from 200 cp up to 200 cp down. Kxg1 recovers the bishop and gives a nominal 130 cp edge. Kh7 is a less effective decline, and g5 and f5 give Black counterplay in the resulting material imbalance.
reviewNotes.level: Two White moves with one genuine queen-for-rook sacrifice. The second move removes the mating-square guard and recovers material immediately, while the final position remains contested.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete Titled Tue 9th May Early game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 96 and previous move Bg1. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Qxe5+ dxe5 Kxg1 with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: A rook sacrifice brings the opposing king to the open file for a second rook check.
reviews.distinctness: Use the two rooks on the same open file in sequence. Compare a bishop-check move order and a premature queen sacrifice.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qh8# và Qh7#. Đen thí Xe bằng ...Rxc2+. Sau Kxc2, ...Rc8+ dùng Xe còn lại để chiếu trên cột c. Nếu Trắng chặn bằng Rc3, Đen có thể tiếp tục ...Be4+.
hintsVi: Tìm cách đưa Vua trắng lên c2 bằng một nước chiếu.
Sau khi Xe đầu tiên bị bắt, quân nào có thể chiếu tiếp trên cột c?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White has Qh8# and Qh7#. Rxc2+ makes White address the check, and after Kxc2 those threats remain. Rc8+ is a second check down the cleared c-file.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qxb2+ gives up the queen without a viable defence in the reviewed line. Be3+ Rxe3 Bxh1 is a plausible different move order. After Rh3, a focused 1.2M-node comparison again finds the Rxc2+ sacrifice as the viable defence.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kxc2 costs a rook for a pawn with no immediate recapture. Kd1 is a weaker refusal in the review. After Rc8+, Rc3 is the strongest interposition, with Be4+ checked as the continuation. Early Be4+ directly after Kxc2 allows Nd3 and is much weaker.
reviewNotes.level: Two Black moves with one accepted rook sacrifice and a clear defensive counterattack. Black gives 400 cp of material to keep forcing replies.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete PCA/Intel-GP game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 47 and previous move Rh3. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Rxc2+ Kxc2 Rc8+ with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: Giving the rook for the knight draws the queen onto d5, after which the king must still find c2.
reviews.distinctness: A rook-for-knight offer preserves more material than immediately fleeing and removes the piece covering nearby escape squares.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Rxd5, thí chất để lấy Mã và kéo Hậu đen khỏi c4. Sau Qxd5, Trắng vẫn phải đi Kc2 để hóa giải đe dọa trên d3. Nếu Đen thử Qxd3+ thì Vua trắng bắt lại bằng Kxd3.
hintsVi: Nếu Vua đi Kc2 ngay, Hậu đen sẽ bắt quân nào? Hãy tìm cách đổi Xe lấy Mã trước khi đưa Vua ra c2.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qxd3# is concrete. Rxd5 removes the knight and covers d3 from d5. After Qxd5, the same threat returns, so Kc2 is the necessary second defence in the reviewed line.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Kc2 immediately allows Qxb5, losing the rook without taking the knight. Nf2 and Nc1 have the same defect. After acceptance, c4 and Ke2 lose the practical position.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxd5 accepts the rook for a knight at net cost 180 cp. After Kc2, Qxd3+ allows Kxd3 and Rxc3+ allows Kxc3. h4 and Ra8 are the most challenging continuations and do not renew the mate.
reviewNotes.level: Two concrete decisions. The sacrifice cuts losses first, and the king move then resolves the renewed mate.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete SuperGM game (2001.02.27) replayed through ply 56 and to the end. Qc4 reaches the exercise. The played continuation is Rxd5 Qxd5 Kc2. Source SHA-256 b2d9883ee1489c06f4aa0f7743b4f1f30674d4e76e3742715a2f5a62d19831b4.

reviews.reason: An exchange sacrifice on a remote square both disarms a mating battery and opens the way for a counterthreat on g2.
reviews.distinctness: Remove the long-range bishop guard from the opposite wing and use the recapture to turn the threat against the other king.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qh8# nhờ Tượng b2. Đen thí chất bằng ...Rxb2 để loại Tượng. Sau Qxb2, ...Qg5 chuyển sang đe dọa Qxg2# với sự hỗ trợ của Tượng b7.
hintsVi: Nhìn đường chéo dài từ b2 tới h8.
Khi Hậu trắng bắt lại ở b2, Hậu đen có thể tạo đe dọa ở cột nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White threatens Qh8# because the bishop on b2 covers h8 once the queen leaves e5. Rxb2 removes the guard and leaves Qh8+ answerable by Kxh8.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qg7 directly challenges the queen but permits Qxg7#. Normal rook and king moves leave Qh8#. Rxb2 is the only viable root and, after Qxb2, Qg5 is much stronger than the available passive defences.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxb2 accepts a rook for bishop with no immediate material recovery. Strong decline Bxg6 is met by Qg7 in the reviewed line. After acceptance, Qg5 threatens Qxg2# with support from Bb7; g3 is a credible reply and has been reviewed.
reviewNotes.level: One exchange sacrifice and a clear counterthreat. Black starts down 200 cp and is down 370 cp after acceptance, so this is an active defence and the lesson does not promise recovery of material.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete FIDE World Rapid Team game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 49 and previous move Qe5. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Rxb2 Qxb2 Qg5 with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: The knight sacrifice draws the queen off the first rank and creates an escape square for the king.
reviews.distinctness: Deflection of a distant piece guarding an escape square, rather than removing support at the mating square.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Ng6+ để kéo Hậu đen khỏi hàng 1. Sau Qxg6, Trắng đi Re1. Nếu Đen chiếu Ra5+ thì Vua trắng đã có đường về b1.
hintsVi: Xe đen dọa Ra5#. Hãy xem vì sao Vua trắng chưa thể chạy về b1 và cách kéo Hậu đen khỏi hàng 1.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Ra5# works while Qg1 prevents Kb1. Ng6+ makes Qxg6 the only legal reply, removing the queen from the first rank. Re1 then controls that rank and allows Kb1 after Ra5+.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qxf5 can also work, but Rxf5 Bxf5 gives up the queen for a rook and pawn, another genuine sacrifice. Qc6 and Re5 allow strong captures of the defender and are materially worse.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After Qxg6 the knight is lost with no immediate recapture. After Re1, Rxc2 Bxc2 is favourable and Ra5+ allows Kb1. Kh7 and Qf6 are stronger practical tries but leave White the initiative.
reviewNotes.level: One clear knight sacrifice. Both the start and response were played, and several checked second moves are available.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Linares game (1994.??.??) replayed through ply 66 and to the end. Rc5 reaches the exercise. The played continuation is Ng6+ Qxg6 Re1. Source SHA-256 9f7227690c26ed05688cf1c118c46585c8d6a69a054764f5ef2649c47aeb292f.

reviews.reason: A knight sacrifice removes one attacker and draws the queen away so the second attacker can be captured safely.
reviews.distinctness: Remove a pawn and knight in the right order. The premature capture allows a different immediate mating move, this time by the pawn.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qh8#. Đen chưa thể chơi ...Qxf7 vì Trắng đáp gxf7#. Đen thí Mã bằng ...Nxg6 để loại Tốt trước. Sau Qxg6, ...Qxf7 bắt Mã và cho phép đổi Hậu nếu Trắng chơi Qxf7+.
hintsVi: Kiểm tra nước bắt Mã f7 ngay. Tốt trắng có thể đáp thế nào?
Tìm cách loại Tốt g6 trước khi bắt Mã f7.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White threatens Qh8#. Qxf7 first allows gxf7#, because the pawn moves with check and opens the queen’s line. Nxg6 first removes that pawn. Qxg6 then draws the White queen off h5 before Qxf7.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Immediate Qxf7 is refuted by an exact mate. Quiet knight and queen moves allow Qh8#. After the accepted sacrifice, Qxf7 is the viable route to removing the knight.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxg6 accepts a knight for a pawn, changing equal material to a 220 cp Black deficit. Qxf7 then recovers the White knight, and Qxf7+ Kxf7 is an equal queen exchange. Nd6 and Ng5 are relevant refusals and have been checked.
reviewNotes.level: Two Black moves with one knight sacrifice and a direct material recovery. The second move offers an equal exchange of queens, so only one sacrifice is present.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete 41st ECC Open 2026 game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 57 and previous move Qh5. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Nxg6 Qxg6 Qxf7 with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: A rook sacrifice brings the king onto the seventh rank and gives the queen access to a checking route.
reviews.distinctness: Bring the queen into the defence after attracting the king. Both accepting immediately and declining with Kg8 lead to different entry checks, unlike the two-rook checking mechanism in 8903 and fe73.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qh1#. Trắng thí Xe bằng Rxf7+. Sau ...Kxf7, Qc7+ tiếp tục chiếu để Đen chưa thể đưa Hậu xuống h1. Chẳng hạn, sau ...Ke8, Trắng có Qc8+.
hintsVi: Tìm nước chiếu đưa Vua đen lên hàng 7.
Hậu trắng có thể chiếu ngay từ ô nào sau khi Xe bị bắt?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Black threatens Qh1#. Rxf7+ makes the king answer. After Kxf7, the mate threat is still present and Qc7+ is the viable countercheck.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Ng1 prevents the initial exact mate but is inferior in the comparison after Qf5. After Kxf7, Nd4 and Nd2 both allow immediate Qh1#. The legal-root comparison supports Qc7+.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kxf7 accepts the rook for a pawn, changing White from 110 cp down to 510 cp down with no immediate recapture. Kg8 is a strong decline checked through Qb8+ Kxf7 Qc7+. Ke8 and Ke6 are serious replies after Qc7+, with further White checks in both cases.
reviewNotes.level: Two White moves with one accepted rook sacrifice. Continued checks provide compensation. The reviewed line does not establish a forced draw.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete 25th Abu Dhabi Masters game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 114 and previous move Qb1. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Rxf7+ Kxf7 Qc7+ with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: The rook offers itself as a shield so that a pawn can replace it on the same line if the offer is accepted.
reviews.distinctness: An interposition that remains intact after the sacrifice is accepted because a pawn can occupy the blocker’s square.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đi Re5, thí chất để chặn đường chéo của Tượng b2. Sau Bxe5, Đen đáp dxe5. Tốt đen thay Xe chắn đường chéo, nên Qh8+ có thể được đáp bằng Kxh8.
hintsVi: Đen có thể chặn đường chéo của Tượng b2 ở e5 bằng quân nào? Nếu Tượng trắng bắt quân chặn, quân nào sẽ thay thế?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The b2 bishop backs the queen’s Qh8# through e5 and f6. Re5 blocks this diagonal. After Bxe5 the blockage must be restored by dxe5.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Passive waiting leaves the immediate mate. Qc3 and Kh7 allow a strong continuation without solving the attacking geometry. After Bxe5, only dxe5 holds up in the all-root comparison.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Bxe5 dxe5 costs an exchange. Qxe5 lets the same pawn take the queen. Qg6+ Kh8 is a serious decline. After dxe5, Qh8+ can be captured and Qg6+ still has a viable king reply.
reviewNotes.level: One simple exchange sacrifice. The learner must see why the second move replaces the rook with a pawn instead of leaving the diagonal open.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete 23rd ECC Men game (2007.10.04) replayed through ply 81 and to the end. Qxf6 reaches the exercise. The played continuation is Re5 Bxe5 dxe5. Source SHA-256 7ec014b95ad9d5c2540287ad7c53ef1ad8cc7fed76d34ad4ae4a5a6fd31f21d6.

reviews.reason: A rook sacrifice clears a diagonal so the solver can capture the mating queen.
reviews.distinctness: Clear d4 with a forcing check. The payoff is an immediate capture of the attacking queen, rather than merely removing its guard or inducing an exchange.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qf3#. Hậu trắng muốn bắt Hậu c3 nhưng Xe d4 đang chắn đường chéo. Rd8+ vừa dọn đường vừa chiếu Vua. Sau ...Rxd8, Qxc3 loại Hậu đang đe dọa chiếu hết.
hintsVi: Quân nào đang chắn đường từ Hậu e5 đến Hậu c3?
Tìm cách dọn đường chéo bằng một nước chiếu.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Black’s queen on c3 threatens Qf3#, with the bishop on c6 guarding f3. The White rook on d4 blocks the White queen’s e5–c3 diagonal. Rd8+ clears that diagonal and gains the tempo for Qxc3.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Re3 blocks the direct mate but the root comparison shows it much weaker. An additional 1.2M-node check after Re3 found strong Qb2+ and Qc2+ continuations. Routine queen moves leave the verified Qf3#.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Rxd8 accepts the whole rook before White can recapture anything, leaving White 730 cp down. Qxc3 then wins the queen and makes White 170 cp up. Be8 is a weaker interposition and also permits Qxc3. fxe6 is a strong material reply checked after the capture.
reviewNotes.level: Two White moves with a clear rook offer and direct recovery. The motif is defensive clearance even though the follow-up gains material.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete Barcelona game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 64 and previous move Rg7. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Rd8+ Rxd8 Qxc3 with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: A rook sacrifice exposes the opposing king so the removal of the mating-square guard has tactical support.
reviews.distinctness: Compare direct removal of the guard on f5 with the same capture after a forcing rook sacrifice on g2. The meaningful difference is the exposed white king, rather than a new attack line on Black’s king.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qxg7# nhờ Mã f5. Trong phương án phân tích, Đen thí Xe bằng ...Rxg2+. Sau Kxg2, ...Nxf5 loại Mã bảo vệ g7. Nếu gxf5, Đen có ...Qg5+ để khai thác vị trí Vua trắng.
hintsVi: Nếu bắt Mã f5 ngay, Xe b2 có an toàn không?
Tìm nước chiếu kéo Vua trắng đến g2 trước khi bắt Mã.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White threatens Qxg7# with Nf5 supporting g7. Rxg2+ attracts the king to g2, then Nxf5 removes the guard. If White recaptures with gxf5, Qg5+ uses the exposed king position.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: The played Nxf5 does stop the immediate mate but allows Qxb2 winning the rook. A 1.2M-node focused comparison after Nxf5 confirms Qxb2 as the stronger resource. Quiet king and queen moves commonly allow Qxg7#.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kxg2 accepts a rook for a pawn, changing a 200 cp Black lead to a 200 cp deficit. Nxf5 recovers a knight before any recapture. Kh1 and Kf1 declines permit Nxf5 with the rook still available. gxf5 and e7 were both considered after the sample.
reviewNotes.level: Two Black moves with one rook sacrifice. The point is to keep enough counterplay to defend after removing the mating guard, rather than merely preventing mate for one move.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete 1st 3-0 Thu 27th Nov 2025 game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 47 and previous move Qd4. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Nxf5 Qxb2 Ne7 with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: The queen is given for the knight that guards h2. The connected passed pawns are the specific compensation after acceptance.
reviews.distinctness: A direct queen-for-knight sacrifice against a mating square, with a pawn advance as compensation after acceptance.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Qxg4, thí Hậu để loại Mã đang giữ h2. Sau Qxg4, Trắng đi c5, tấn công Tượng trên b6 và tạo sức ép bằng hai Tốt thông c và d.
hintsVi: Quân nào bảo vệ h2? Nếu phải đổi Hậu để loại quân đó, Trắng có thể tạo phản công bằng hai Tốt nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Ng4 supports Qh2#. Qxg4 removes the knight, so Qh2+ can be answered by Kxh2. Passive rook moves leave the mating attack.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Bxe5+ and Qxe5+ offer counterchecks but both allow Rxe5 and a far worse position. Passive rook repositioning fails against the queen. There is no equally practical non-sacrificial start.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxg4 accepts the queen offer at a real net cost of 580 cp. Bxf2+ is met by Kxf2 and Qxg2+ by Kxg2. After c5, Bxc5 allows Bxc5 or Rxc5. Ba7 is the strongest reviewed branch; the c- and d-pawns are passed and give genuine counterplay.
reviewNotes.level: Simple single queen offer followed by a direct pawn advance. White begins a rook up in nominal material but the mating threat makes the decision essential.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Cez Trophy Rapid Match game (2007.08.30) replayed through ply 64 and to the end. Ng4 reaches the exercise. The played continuation is Qxg4 Qxg4 c5. Source SHA-256 a4e5dc4346591e446f892ece52e42d9ee781539bc5c9071341675635f2f63e5a.

reviews.reason: A quiet exchange sacrifice removes the shared diagonal guard without first spending a countercheck.
reviews.distinctness: Choose a quiet removal of a bishop over a premature countercheck, then exploit the actual queen recapture with the deferred countercheck.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qg7# và Qh8# nhờ Tượng e5. Đen chơi ...Rxe5 để loại Tượng. Sau Qxe5, ...Qe3+ mới phát huy tác dụng. Nếu Rf2, Đen có thể bắt Tốt bằng ...Qxe4.
hintsVi: Quân nào bảo vệ cả g7 lẫn h8 khi Hậu trắng đến đó?
Xét thời điểm chiếu ở e3. Trước hết cần xử lý quân bảo vệ nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bishop e5 supports both Qh8# and Qg7#. Rxe5 removes that bishop. Both original checks now expose the queen to a capture by the Black king.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Immediate Qe3+ allows Rf2 and leaves White a strong attack. The apparently active Re6 even adds Qxf7# to the immediate threats. After Qxe5, Qe3+ and quieter defences such as Re8 were verified.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxe5 accepts the exchange sacrifice with no immediate recapture, leaving Black 70 cp down from a 100 cp initial lead. White counterchecks such as Qxf7+ and Qd8+ lose material. In the sample, Qe3+ Rf2 Qxe4 regains a pawn.
reviewNotes.level: Two Black moves with one exchange sacrifice. Move order matters because the same queen check is inferior before the bishop is removed.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete Atyrau Chess Masters Open game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 43 and previous move Bxe5. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Rxe5 Qxe5 Qe3+ with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: The bishop sacrifice draws the queen away from the h-file, then the knight attacks the remaining rook.
reviews.distinctness: Queen deflection off a mating file followed by a move against the second attacking piece.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Bxf7+, thí Tượng để kéo Hậu khỏi cột h. Sau Qxf7, phương án luyện tập là Nd3 để tấn công Xe f2. Trong ván đấu, Trắng chọn Rg1.
hintsVi: Hậu h5 và Xe f2 phối hợp chiếu hết ở h2. Trắng có thể kéo Hậu rời cột h rồi tấn công Xe bằng quân nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qxh2# is backed by Rf2. Bxf7+ makes the queen move to f7 in the strongest branch. Nd3 then attacks the rook still on f2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: h4 and h3 are refuted in reviewed lines starting Qxh4+ and Qxh3+. Quiet alternatives leave the immediate mate. After acceptance, Rf5 is also fully reviewed and viable.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxf7 accepts the bishop for a pawn and is stronger than Rxf7 or Kxf7. After Nd3, Ra2 keeps the rook and is the strongest reviewed reply. Rxh2+ now allows Kxh2. The actual game used Rg1 rather than Nd3.
reviewNotes.level: The single bishop offer is necessary to divert the queen. The second move makes the remaining attacker answer a threat.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Titled Tue 2nd Apr Late game (2024.04.02) replayed through ply 46 and to the end. Rxf2 reaches the exercise. The played continuation is Bxf7+ Qxf7 Rg1. Source SHA-256 b2d9883ee1489c06f4aa0f7743b4f1f30674d4e76e3742715a2f5a62d19831b4.

reviews.reason: The queen interposes and is given for the rook guarding h3. The king recapture completes the defence.
reviews.distinctness: A queen-for-rook sacrifice places the king where it can capture the remaining queen on the mating square.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đi Qg2, thí Hậu để kéo Xe đen khỏi g3. Sau Rxg2+ Kxg2, Xe đen không còn bảo vệ h3. Nếu Đen chiếu Qxh3+ thì Vua trắng có thể bắt Hậu.
hintsVi: Xe đen đang giữ h3. Trắng có thể dùng Hậu kéo Xe rời ô g3 để Vua bắt lại ở đâu?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qxh3# is backed by Rg3. Qg2 protects h3 and offers the queen. After Rxg2+ Kxg2, the rook is gone and Qxh3+ permits Kxh3.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Most routine moves allow Qxh3#. The queen block is the only viable root in the complete comparison.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Rxg2+ Kxg2 is an unequal queen-for-rook exchange at net cost 400 cp. Qxh3+ can be met by Qxh3 before acceptance and Kxh3 afterward. Qg6+ is the strongest tested follow-up and allows Kf2.
reviewNotes.level: Single queen sacrifice, with the recapture forming the visible defensive payoff.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete C'Chartres Blitz M Final game (2020.06.14) replayed through ply 84 and to the end. Rxg3 reaches the exercise. The played continuation is Qg2 Rxg2+ Kxg2. Source SHA-256 7ec014b95ad9d5c2540287ad7c53ef1ad8cc7fed76d34ad4ae4a5a6fd31f21d6.

reviews.reason: A rook sacrifice draws a pawn away from the h-file, opening the second rook check.
reviews.distinctness: Clear an enemy pawn from the h-file by offering a rook with check. Unlike 8903, the first check does not depend on drawing the king to a new square.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qxf2#. Trắng thí Xe bằng Rxg6+ để kéo Tốt h7 khỏi cột h. Sau ...hxg6, Rh8+ mở đợt chiếu tiếp theo. Nếu ...Kf7, Trắng có Qf3+.
hintsVi: Nếu cột h thông, Xe h1 có thể chiếu từ đâu?
Tìm nước chiếu khiến Tốt h7 rời cột h.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Black threatens Qxf2# from b2. Rxg6+ makes Black answer, and after hxg6 the mate threat is still present. The h-file is now clear for Rh8+.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: The apparent try Bh8 and quiet rook moves allow Qxf2#. After hxg6, the same mate refutes ordinary moves and Rh8+ is the viable countercheck.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: hxg6 accepts the rook for a pawn, moving White from 420 cp down to 820 cp down. Kf7 is a weaker decline after the reviewed dxe6+. After Rh8+, Kf7 is the only legal king reply and Qf3+ continues the defence. The sample does not claim a forced draw.
reviewNotes.level: Two White moves with an accepted rook sacrifice and distinct h-file clearance. The initial deficit is meaningful because normal consolidation fails to mate.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete 2nd 3-0 Thu 1st Oct 2026 game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 46 and previous move fxg6. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Rxg6+ hxg6 Rh8+ with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: A quiet exchange sacrifice removes a distant bishop guard, and the way Black recaptures determines White’s active response.
reviews.distinctness: Remove the distant guard of b2, then distinguish a queen recapture from the played pawn recapture.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qxb2# vì Tượng f6 bảo vệ b2. Trắng thí chất bằng Rxf6 để loại Tượng. Trong phương án phân tích ...Qxf6, Bb5 giữ các ô a6 và c6 gần Vua đen. Ván đấu diễn ra ...gxf6 Qd8, tấn công Xe c7.
hintsVi: Ngoài Hậu, quân đen nào đang bảo vệ b2?
So sánh hai cách Đen bắt lại trên f6.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The bishop on f6 protects b2 along f6–e5–d4–c3–b2 once the queen moves. Rxf6 removes that protection, so Qxb2 no longer mates.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qd8 and Qxf7 allow Qxb2# at the initial root. Rxf6 is the only root above the viability cutoff. After Qxf6, Bb5 and the separately checked g4 and h5 are viable, so the teaching line does not imply that Bb5 is unique.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxf6 and the played gxf6 both cost the exchange, moving White from 100 cp up to 70 cp down. Qxf6 Bb5 keeps White active, with Bc6 available against Qf2. The actual game used gxf6 Qd8. Declining with Qg1+ is inferior in the reviewed engine comparison.
reviewNotes.level: One rook-for-bishop sacrifice, with a calm second move in the analysis line and a distinct queen attack on c7 in the played line.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed the complete Linares game from the checksummed archive, including source ply 76 and previous move Ka7. Verified the master credential and compared the recorded continuation Rxf6 gxf6 Qd8 with the teaching line.

reviews.reason: A bishop sacrifice activates a queen countercheck while preserving a dangerous passed pawn.
reviews.distinctness: Calculate a queen check across the c3–g7 diagonal with a pawn on f7 in reserve. Unlike 0021, the compensation depends on the promotion threat and an attacked rook, rather than an immediate queen trade.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qxh2# với Xe e2 bảo vệ h2. Trắng thí Tượng bằng Bxg7+. Sau ...Kxg7, Qc3+ chiếu theo đường chéo c3–g7. Nếu ...Qe5 chặn chiếu, Trắng có thể bắt Xe bằng Rxe2.
hintsVi: Tìm nước chiếu thay đổi vị trí Vua đen.
Sau khi Vua đến g7, so sánh nước chiếu bằng Hậu với việc phong cấp ngay.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Black threatens Qxh2# from h5 with the rook on e2 protecting h2. Bxg7+ takes the king to g7 in the sample, where Qc3+ makes Black address the check before playing the mate.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qxe2 is met by Bxe2 and is materially inferior. h3 and h4 also leave strong tactics against White. After Kxg7, premature f8=Q+ is met by Rxf8, while Qc3+ is the viable check.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kxg7 wins a bishop for a pawn, moving White from 100 cp up to 130 cp down. Ke7 is a serious decline checked against promotion. Qe5 and Re5 are strong interpositions to Qc3+. The Qe5 branch gives White Rxe2, with further tactics still available to Black.
reviewNotes.level: Two White moves, one short sacrifice and a visible forcing follow-up. The passed pawn supplies counterplay without requiring the exercise to claim a later win.
