reviews.reason: The rook sacrifice removes the pawn that guards b3, covers the mating square and gains time for promotion. Strong checks then force two unique king evasions. The checks after the fourth move give Black several equally workable escapes.
reviews.distinctness: A rook sacrifice removes the pawn guarding the king’s flight square before a single pawn promotes. Pribelszky–Bologan promotes after two defensive king moves and uses connected pawns, whereas Kholmov promotes first and then must find the king route against rook and knight checks.
reviews.solutionVi: 47...Rxa2 — Xe đen từ g2 bắt Tốt trắng ở a2, loại quân đang bảo vệ b3. Trắng nhận thí Xe bằng 48.Rxa2, cho Đen thời gian phong Hậu bằng 48...h1=Q. Trong ván đấu, Trắng chiếu 49.Ra4+ và Đen thoát chiếu bằng 49...Kxb3. Sau 50.Nc5+, Vua đen phải đi 50...Kb2. Nếu Trắng tiếp tục chiếu Rb4+, Vua đen có thể thoát qua c1 hoặc a2.
hintsVi: Trắng dọa Ra4#. Quân trắng nào đang khống chế ô b3, và Xe đen có thể bắt quân đó bằng nước nào?
Sau khi phong Hậu, hãy tính trước hai nước chiếu Ra4+ và Nc5+.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White threatens Ra4#. Rxa2 removes the pawn guarding b3, while the rook on a2 also covers a4. The strongest acceptance Rxa2 spends the tempo Black needs for h1=Q. White can still try Ra4+, but Kxb3 is now legal because the a2-pawn is gone. The follow-up Nc5+ forces Kb2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 20 initial roots and every later legal root independently replayed. Seventeen alternatives allow immediate Ra4#, Rd2+ permits a bounded mate, and Rg3+ is decisively worse. Rook underpromotion after Rxa2 Rxa2 reaches a drawable bounded position, but the strong Ra4+ still forces Kxb3 and then Nc5+ Kb2. Thus the drawing alternative does not avoid the third or fourth defensive move.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Rxa2 is a genuine rook-for-pawn offer, with no immediate recapture and a net 400 loss from the initial balance. Promotion restores and exceeds the lost material. After h1=Q the quiet Nd2 is slightly stronger, but Ra4+ is competitive and was played. The subsequent Kxb3 and Kb2 are the sole legal moves. After Kb2, supplemental full four-root analysis against the strongest Rb4+ found all four evasions retain a substantial advantage, including the played Kc1. The subsequent checks do not demand another precise defence.
reviewNotes.level: Four necessary solver moves against the strong checking branch, including two sole evasions. The original mate is removed, the rook sacrifice is recovered by promotion, and the residual check has multiple robust replies.
reviewNotes.provenance: Vorotnikov–Kholmov, Moscow Open 1995 round 3, PGN Mentor Kholmov archive. Complete replay reached the original FEN after 47.Kd3. The bound solution through 50...Kb2 and the following 51.Rb4+ Kc1 were played.

reviews.reason: Four moves convert the knight offer into a king capture that removes the mating piece and leaves sound endgame compensation.
reviews.distinctness: The two knights can switch roles. The first check diverts the f-pawn, and the other knight checks twice to free the black king to take the attacking knight.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Re6# và Ng6#. Đen thí Mã bằng 51...Ndxe3+ để kéo Tốt f2 sang e3. Sau 52.fxe3 Nxe3+ 53.Kg3 Nf1+ 54.Kf2, Đen đi 54...Kxf4, bắt Mã đang hỗ trợ đòn chiếu hết. Nếu Trắng bắt Mã còn lại bằng 55.Kxf1, Đen có thể phản công bằng Rd1+ hoặc đẩy Tốt thông h5.
hintsVi: Mã nào của Trắng tham gia vào cả hai đòn chiếu hết?
Hai Mã đen có thể dùng các nước chiếu ở e3 và f1 để giành thời gian cho Vua bắt Mã f4 như thế nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White threatens Re6# and Ng6#. The accepted Ndxe3+ sacrifice draws the f-pawn to e3, where the other knight captures it with check. Nf1+ buys time to remove the f4-knight, which protects e6 and can give mate from g6. After Kxf1, Black’s passed pawns support play in the remaining rook-versus-rook-and-knight ending.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Nineteen of 22 roots allow immediate mate. Ngxe3+ is also sound and transposes after fxe3 Nxe3+, with the knights exchanging roles. Rd6 remains playable, but independent 1M-node checks found strong Ng6+ and Rc5+ and recurring checks after the former, with no shorter resolution. After fxe3, Rd2+ keeps the danger through a checking sequence. After Kg3, the other playable choices leave renewed checks or further unresolved material compensation. Kxf4 is the strongest endpoint and removes the mating knight.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After Ndxe3+, fxe3 is strongest, while Kg3 and Kh3 allow Black’s checking counterplay. After Nxe3+, Kg3 is strongest, and Kf2 and Kh3 permit Kxf4. After Nf1+, both Kf2 and Kg2 allow Kxf4. The strongest Kxf1 after Kxf4 concedes no immediate mate to White and leaves multiple sound plans for Black. Independent 1M-node all-root evidence found Rd1+, h5, Kf3 and the played e3 all viable. Every opponent move was screened and all checks and captures received deeper coverage.
reviewNotes.level: Four solver moves against the strongest played branch. The accepted knight-for-pawn offer is necessary to the coordination. Even after the second knight is taken in the game continuation, the passed pawns supply material compensation and the original mates are gone.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Topalov–Sulava game, Aiacciu Masters, Ajaccio, 25 October 2004, Topalov archive. Original FEN follows 51.Nf4. All seven sample plies were played, followed by 55.Kxf1 e3. Rd1+ and h5 are analysis.

reviews.reason: Two purposeful offers sustain the countercheck until the queen captures the mating rook.
reviews.distinctness: Rook and bishop offers keep the defending queen checking and move the mating rook from f8 to f4.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Rh8#. Đen thí Xe bằng 44...Rxg3+ và đáp 45.Kxg3 bằng 45...Qg1+. Sau 46.Kf3 Qf1+ 47.Kg3, Đen thí Tượng bằng 47...Bf4+ để kéo Xe trắng khỏi f8. Sau 48.Rxf4, Trắng dọa Rh4#. Đen bắt Xe bằng 48...Qxf4+ và hóa giải đe dọa.
hintsVi: Đen cần giữ nhịp chiếu để Xe trắng chưa thể xuống h8. Hãy xét nước chiếu bằng Xe ở g3.
Sau khi Vua trắng trở lại g3, quân đen nào có thể chiếu và kéo Xe trắng đến f4?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White threatens Rh8#. Rxg3+ forces king to g3. The two queen checks retain the initiative, and Bf4+ forces White’s rook to take, renewing mate on h4 instead.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Re2+ at the start and Qe3+ later can hold with a longer checking continuation. Qg1+ instead of Bf4+ merely returns to the same tactical position. There is no earlier comparable resolution in the reviewed continuations.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After Bf4+ Rxf4 White threatens Rh4#. Qxf4+ removes the rook that sustains the threat. exf4+ is worse and allows a continuing contest. The strongest played Kg2 does not renew immediate mate, and the engine line shows follow-up advantage, not a forced win claim.
reviewNotes.level: Five necessary moves on the played counterchecking defence, including genuine rook and bishop sacrifices.
reviewNotes.provenance: Demchenko,A–Nepomniachtchi,I, Chess.com Rapid Wk4 Swiss, 2022.03.05. Exact preceding move and full source at ply 87. Fully played. https://www.pgnmentor.com/players/Nepomniachtchi.zip

reviews.reason: The knight sacrifice opens a checking file, and two counterchecks force Black to expose the mating queen. The fourth move takes that queen. Strong immediate recaptures leave no further forcing attack and several viable continuations.
reviews.distinctness: Knight sacrifice opens the h-file for the queen. A later bishop check makes the mating queen capturable by a rook on either d5 or e5.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qxb2#. Trắng đi Nxg6+ — Mã từ e7 đến g6, bắt Tốt và chiếu. Sau hxg6, cột h mở cho Qh3+. Đen đáp Kg8, rồi Trắng chiếu tiếp Bd5+. Sau Qxd5, Xe từ d1 bắt Hậu đen bằng Rxd5. Ván đấu tiếp diễn cxd5. Nếu Đen chọn cxd5 ngay sau Bd5+, Trắng bắt Hậu bằng Rxe5.
hintsVi: Trắng có thể dùng Mã để kéo Tốt h7 ra khỏi cột h bằng nước chiếu nào?
Sau khi Vua đen đến g8, Tượng trắng có thể chiếu theo đường chéo nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: After Kh8, Black threatens Qxb2#. The direct knight sacrifice Nxg6+ forces the h-pawn off the h-file in the strongest reply. Qh3+ and Bd5+ interrupt the same renewed mate and compel one of two captures on d5. Rxd5 or Rxe5 then removes the mating queen.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Independently replayed all 181 legal solver roots across the four sample steps. Forty-five of 51 starting moves allow immediate mate; c3, Qc3 and Nd4 avoid it but are materially inferior in the screened lines. The alternate starting capture or queen move does not secure the mate defence. The first three best counterchecks are distinct necessary decisions along the strong branch. After Qxd5, Rxd5 is the only holding choice in the bounded review.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Independently replayed all 32 legal replies across the four sample turns. Reviewed Kg8 as the alternative to taking the first knight and Bh6 as the alternative to Kg8 on the next check. At Bd5+, both cxd5 and Qxd5 are strong. A 1M full-history check confirms only Rxe5 holds after cxd5. Its recapture Bxe5 allows several quiet viable choices such as Rxd5, Qd3, Qf3 or Qh6. After the played Qxd5 Rxd5 cxd5, another 1M full-history check gives Qg3 and Qf3 +11 nominal cp and Qd3 +9. Both strongest recaptures leave White 260 nominal cp down but without pending mate or a fresh forced response. The claim is king safety against the original attack, with sufficient activity, rather than winning material.
reviewNotes.level: Four connected solver moves with an accepted knight sacrifice. Three successive checks manage the renewed b2 mate threat and the fourth move removes the attacking queen. Strong recaptures permit ordinary play with more than one viable continuation.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed all 57 plies of Shirov–Dowgird, Titled Tuesday August 2024, from the PGN Mentor Shirov archive. Black played 20...Kh8, and the full sample through 24.Rxd5 was played. Black's 24...cxd5 is also the recorded move.

reviews.reason: The pawn block and bishop offer permit the queen to switch diagonals and take the bishop controlling the mating square.
reviews.distinctness: Two deliberate offers and queen counterchecks secure the g3 square and remove the guard of h2.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qxh2#. Trắng đi 33.g3 để chắn đường Hậu. Sau 33...Bxg3, Trắng thí Tượng bằng 34.Bxf7+ để kéo Vua đen ra f7. Trắng tiếp tục 35.Qa2+ Kf8 36.Qa3+ Re7, rồi 37.Qxg3 bắt Tượng đang bảo vệ ô h2. Nếu Đen chiếu 37...Qe4+, Trắng có thể đáp 38.Kg1 hoặc 38.Qg2.
hintsVi: Tốt trắng có thể chắn đường Hậu đến h2 bằng nước nào?
Sau khi Tượng đen đến g3, hãy dùng các nước chiếu để Hậu trắng đến được đường chéo a3–g3.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qxh2# is the initial threat. g3 blocks the queen but permits Bxg3, and Bxf7+ draws the king out to give the queen the tempo for two checks.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Only g3 is viable initially. After Bxg3, f6 is also viable but still needs a longer defensive sequence under Re3. Qa2+, Qa3+ and Qxg3 are the sole viable moves in the last three sample frames.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Re7 and Bd6 are close strong replies after Qa3+, both threaten Qxh2#. Qxg3 removes the supporting bishop on the played path. Best remaining Qe4+ allows both Kg1 and Qg2 at a supplemental full-root 800k check. Qg2 can trade queens; reviewed further checks no longer restore the original mating net.
reviewNotes.level: Five moves with a direct pawn block, a bishop sacrifice to gain tempi, and a necessary capture that ends the mate threat. The residual Qe4+ has two equally sound evasions.
reviewNotes.provenance: Grischuk,A–Rublevsky,S, WCh Candidates Finals, 2007.06.13. Exact preceding move and full source at ply 64. Fully played. https://www.pgnmentor.com/players/Rublevsky.zip

reviews.reason: Two direct sacrifices clear the queen’s diagonal and draw the mating rook onto a square the queen can take. Each step until the rook capture is tied to the original mate threat.
reviews.distinctness: A knight clearance sacrifice on d6 followed by a bishop decoy sacrifice on g4. The queen then checks along the cleared diagonal and captures the diverted rook, forcing the strongest queen exchange.
reviews.solutionVi: 27.Nxd6+ — Mã trắng từ c4 bắt Tốt ở d6 và chiếu, mở đường chéo b3–e6 cho Hậu. Sau 27...Nxd6, Trắng thí tiếp Tượng bằng 28.Bg4+ để kéo Xe đen đến g4. Ván đấu tiếp tục 28...Rxg4 29.Qe6+ Kc7. Trắng đi 30.Qxg4, bắt Xe và bảo vệ h3. Sau 30...Qxg4 31.hxg4, hai Hậu được đổi và đe dọa chiếu hết ở h3 đã hết.
hintsVi: Đen dọa Qxh3#. Nước chiếu nào vừa mở đường chéo b3–e6 cho Hậu trắng?
Hãy tìm cách kéo Xe đen đến ô mà Hậu trắng có thể tấn công từ e6.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Black threatens Qxh3#. The c4-knight blocks the queen’s b3–e6 diagonal, so Nxd6+ clears that line with tempo. Bg4+ draws the rook from g8 to g4. Qe6+ simultaneously checks and attacks g4. Qxg4 removes the rook and defends h3.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All legal roots at all four frames independently replayed. Immediate Bg4+ is decisively inferior. The initial Nb6+ can hold in bounded play, but its forcing line still has unresolved checks beyond four moves. At the second move Qe6+ is inferior but playable. Supplemental analysis of Qe6+ Kc7 found Rg1 as the only sound third move at the tested budget, and Rxg1+ then requires a fourth solver move Rxg1. Ba6+ also requires a longer defence. After the bishop offer, Qe6+ and Qxg4 are the sole viable moves at their respective frames.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Nxd6 accepts the knight at a net 220 cost and Rxg4 accepts the bishop at a 330 cost. Strong declines are worse. Qe6+ remains effective after either strong king reply Kc7 or Kb7. Qxg4 earns a rook, and Black’s strongest immediate Qxg4 is an equal queen exchange after hxg4. Material recovery survives the recapture and Black has no renewed mating threat.
reviewNotes.level: Four connected moves, with two independent accepted sacrifices and a defensible endpoint after the forced tactical recovery. Shorter serious defences were not established.
reviewNotes.provenance: Wongso–Dushyant Sharma, Marshall Summer Inv IMB, New York 2026 round 4.3, The Week in Chess 1653. Complete replay reached the original FEN after 26...Qh4. The bound line through 30.Qxg4 and the following 30...Qxg4 31.hxg4 were played.

reviews.reason: The rook sacrifice removes the attacking bishop. White then chooses the king square that can recapture the remaining attacking rook when it takes the interposing knight.
reviews.distinctness: A knight interposition gives way to an exchange sacrifice against a bishop check. The king then removes the second mating support on e2, returning to the original material balance.
reviews.solutionVi: 28.Ne2 — Mã trắng từ c3 đến e2 để chắn Xe chiếu. Sau 28...Bg3+, Trắng thí Xe bằng 29.Rxg3, loại Tượng đang tấn công. Ván đấu tiếp tục 29...Qxg3+ 30.Kf1 Rxe2. Đen dọa Qxg2#, nên Trắng bắt Xe bằng 31.Kxe2. Nếu Đen chiếu Qxg2+, Vua trắng có thể thoát qua d3, d1 hoặc e1.
hintsVi: Hãy tìm quân có thể chắn đường chiếu trên hàng hai mà vẫn giữ được Vua trắng.
Sau khi Hậu đen bắt Xe ở g3, Vua trắng cần đứng ở đâu để có thể bắt Xe nếu Xe đen đến e2?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: After 27...Rxb2+, Ne2 blocks the rook’s check. The strong Bg3+ cannot be met by Kf1 because Qh1+ forces Ng1 and Qxg2#. Rxg3 removes the bishop, and Qxg3+ forces Kf1 as the viable king move. Rxe2 threatens Qxg2#, so Kxe2 removes the supporting rook.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All legal roots at all four frames independently replayed. At the start Kf1 allows Qh1# and Ke1 is decisively inferior. Kf1 against Bg3+ leads to a mate, and Kg1 against Qxg3+ loses its material position. The sound final counterchecks Qf8+ and Bxg7+ still require Kxe2, so neither shortens the defence.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxg3+ is the strongest acceptance of Rxg3 and the actual cost is a rook for bishop, 170 on the project scale. On the strongest Rxe2, Kxe2 restores the material and removes the mating support. The strongest residual Qxg2+ was played. Supplemental all-four-root comparison at 1.5 million nodes finds three king moves Kd3, Ke1 and Kd1 retain a clear advantage, while Qf2 does not. The remaining check is handled with ordinary king safety once the support is gone.
reviewNotes.level: Four necessary connected decisions. The sacrifice is purposeful and accepted, the mate is stopped and the material recovered at the fourth move. The residual check is handled by multiple safe king routes.
reviewNotes.provenance: Ponomariov–Frolyanov, Chessable Masters Play-In 2024 round 1, PGN Mentor Ponomariov archive. Complete replay reached the exact FEN after 27...Rxb2+. The bound line through 31.Kxe2 and subsequent 31...Qxg2+ 32.Kd3 were played.

reviews.reason: Five moves give up the rook, countercheck twice, and put the queen on g4 to cover the renewed mating square.
reviews.distinctness: The sacrifice transfers the initiative briefly. The queen uses the checking tempo to reach a quiet defensive square on the file that the attacking queen and rook are targeting.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đang bị Hậu chiếu. Sau 34...Kh7, Trắng đi 35.Qf7 và dọa Qxg7#. Đen thí Xe bằng 35...Rxg2+, bắt Tượng để giành nhịp phản công. Sau 36.Kxg2 Qf1+ 37.Kh2 Qe2+ 38.Kh1, Đen đi 38...Qg4, dùng Hậu bảo vệ g7 dọc cột g. Nếu Trắng bắt ở g7, Đen có thể bắt lại bằng Hậu.
hintsVi: Sau Qf7, Hậu và Xe trắng cùng nhắm đến ô nào?
Đen có thể dùng các nước chiếu để đưa Hậu đến một ô bảo vệ g7 như thế nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Kh7 meets the initial queen check, and Qf7 renews the mate on g7. Rxg2+ gives up a rook for the bishop to gain time, with Kxg2 as the strong acceptance. The two queen checks transfer the queen to e2. Qg4 then covers g7 before White can play Qxg7#.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Kf8 immediately allows Qf7#. Kh8 is viable, but an independent all-root probe finds Rc8+ leading to repeated queen checks or Qf7 renewing the same threat. After Qf7, all alternatives to Rxg2+ allow immediate mate or receive a losing mate score in the bounded analysis. Qb2+ and Qf2+ are viable later checking alternatives and prolong the pressure. Before the fifth move, Qg4 is the only viable quiet root in an independent 1M-node all-root comparison. Other viable roots keep checking.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After Rxg2+, Kh3 allows Qh1# and the strong Kxg2 keeps the mate threat alive. Qf1+ allows only Kh2. After Qe2+, both Kh1 and Kh3 are viable, with Qg4+ also playable after Kh3. At the endpoint the strongest White moves Kh2 and Kg2 create no immediate mate threat. The direct test Qxg7+ Qxg7 Rxg7+ Kxg7 leaves Black better in the stored evidence. All legal replies were screened and every check and capture received deeper coverage.
reviewNotes.level: Five necessary solver moves to reach the sample’s quiet defensive endpoint. The exchange sacrifice is accepted and its compensation is the checking initiative that allows a permanent defence of g7 in the resulting position.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Nguyen Ha Thi Hai–Bluebaum game, Titled Tuesday, 8 September 2026, TWIC 1662. Original FEN follows 34.Qd5+. All nine sample plies were played. The capture sequence on g7 is analysis.

reviews.reason: Four moves give up the exchange to remove the bishop and trade away the remaining attacking rook. The strongest later queen check has multiple sound answers.
reviews.distinctness: White uses both rooks in succession. The first removes support for the mating square and the second interposes with a protected exchange.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đang chiếu bằng Tượng ở d5. Trắng thí Xe lấy Tượng bằng 56.Rxd5, loại bỏ quân đang bảo vệ h1. Sau 56...Qxd5+ 57.Kg1 Re1+, Trắng đi 58.Rf1, dùng Xe còn lại chặn chiếu. Sau 58...Rxf1+ 59.Kxf1, Xe đen đã bị loại khỏi cuộc tấn công. Nếu Đen chiếu tiếp bằng Qf5+, Trắng có thể chặn bằng Qf2 như trong ván đấu.
hintsVi: Tượng đen ở d5 đang bảo vệ ô chiếu hết nào?
Khi Xe đen chiếu từ e1, Xe trắng có thể chặn ở đâu để Vua bắt lại nếu Đen đổi Xe?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rxd5 removes the checking bishop that controls h1, and White gives up a rook for it after Qxd5+. Kg1 answers the queen check, and the remaining rook blocks Re1+. Kxf1 eliminates the final attacking rook after the exchange.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Kg1 at the start allows Qh1#, and the other three starting alternatives are decisively inferior. After Qxd5+, Kh2 is playable, but the engine continuation still requires Kg1 and the rook exchange after Qh5+. After Re1+ and after Rxf1+, the alternative Kh2 allows Rh1# in each case.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxd5+ is the strongest acceptance, and Re1+ is the strongest continuation against Kg1. Rf1 allows the strong Rxf1+ and only Kxf1 survives it. At the endpoint, Qf5+ can be answered with Qf2, Kg1 or Ke1 with robust compensation in the independent 1M-node all-root review. The source used Qf2 and Black then took g6. The remaining queen checks are manageable. Every legal reply was screened and every check and capture received deeper coverage.
reviewNotes.level: Four moves are necessary against the played checks. The first rook is a genuine exchange sacrifice. The second rook is traded, with immediate recovery, to neutralize the mating attack. White’s queen and knight remain.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Alekhine–Castillo Larenas game, Buenos Aires Olympiad, 1939, Alekhine archive. Original FEN follows 55...Bxd5+. All seven sample plies were played, then 59...Qf5+ 60.Qf2.

reviews.reason: The preparatory rook check gets the rook out of attack. White can then sacrifice the queen to remove the mating rook, take the pawn and finish with a precise king move that guards the other rook.
reviews.distinctness: The queen-for-rook pattern differs from Leko–Anand and Bacrot–Makarian. The first rook must escape its attacker with check, and the fifth move defends the other rook directly with the king.
reviews.solutionVi: 38.Rc8+ — Xe trắng từ c5 đến c8, vừa chiếu Vua vừa tránh bị Tốt b6 bắt. Sau 38...Kh7, Trắng thí Hậu bằng 39.Qxf2 để loại Xe đang bảo vệ g2. Đen nhận thí Hậu bằng 39...exf2+ và Trắng bắt lại Tốt với 40.Kxf2. Trong ván đấu, Đen tiếp tục 40...Qf4+ 41.Kg2 Qd2+. Trắng phải đi 42.Kf1 để vừa tránh chiếu vừa bảo vệ Xe e1.
hintsVi: Nếu Trắng bắt Xe ở f2 ngay, Tốt đen ở b6 có thể bắt Xe nào?
Sau khi loại Xe f2, hãy tính cách giữ Xe e1 trước hai nước chiếu Qf4+ và Qd2+.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White must prevent Qg2#, which the rook on f2 supports. Rc8+ takes the c5-rook out of the b6-pawn’s attack with tempo. Qxf2 then removes the mating support. exf2+ renews the pressure, and after Kxf2 the strongest checks require Kg2 and Kf1 to keep the e1-rook safe.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 35 initial roots and all later legal roots independently replayed. The direct Qxf2 exf2+ Kxf2 Qd4+ Ke2 bxc5 loses the unprepared rook. After Rc8+ Kh7 only Qxf2 is viable. After exf2+, Kxf2 is the only sound evasion. After Qf4+, 41.Ke2 fails to Qh2+ in the bound targeted comparison and in a 2-million-node recheck, and Kg1 is also inferior. After 41.Kg2 Qd2+, only 42.Kf1 survives the full six-root comparison.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: The accepted Qxf2 is a queen for rook offer, a net 400-point cost at acceptance before Kxf2 recovers the pawn. Kf1 guards e1, so Qxe1+ loses to Kxe1. At the endpoint Qxa2 is quiet, and Qd3+ has several viable replies including Kg2, Re2 and Kf2. The strong alternative Qf4+ has the safe response Kg2, which restores the earlier verified position after 41.Kg2 without a new tactical decision. The drawn score is bounded evidence and does not establish an automatic draw.
reviewNotes.level: Five connected solver moves. The added Kf1 is necessary to save the rook against the strongest check, and the remaining queen checks either have multiple sound replies or return to a previously solved position. No shorter viable defence was established.
reviewNotes.provenance: Ragger–Navara, Prague Masters, Prague 15 February 2020 round 4.1, PGN Mentor Navara archive. Complete game replay reaches the exact FEN after 37...Rf2. The full five-move solution through 42.Kf1 was played. The immediate 42...Qf4+ return is analysis.

reviews.reason: Five White moves remove the bishop supporting mate, recover material by promotion, and bring the king to b4 to defend the knight against the strongest queen checks.
reviews.distinctness: Vorotnikov–Kholmov also gives up a rook before promoting, then faces checks by a rook and knight. Here the opposing queen is already active. The king’s three-move route has to keep the white knight safe as the queen checks from different files.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qe2#. Trắng thí Xe bằng 54.Rxf3, bắt Tượng đang bảo vệ e2. Sau 54...Qxf3, Trắng phong Hậu bằng 55.b8=Q để bù lại vật chất. Đen tiếp tục 55...Qxe4+ 56.Kd2 Qxd5+ 57.Kc3 Qd4+. Trắng đi 58.Kb4, vừa thoát chiếu vừa bảo vệ Mã ở c4. Nếu Đen chiếu tiếp bằng Qc5+, Trắng có thể đi Kb3 và vẫn giữ Mã.
hintsVi: Quân nào bảo vệ e2 cho đòn chiếu hết của Đen? Trắng có thể loại bỏ quân đó trước khi phong cấp bằng cách nào?
Sau khi phong Hậu, hãy tìm đường cho Vua tránh các nước chiếu của Hậu đen mà vẫn giữ được Mã c4.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bxf3 sets up Qe2# with bishop support. Rxf3 removes that support and gives up the exchange to Qxf3. Immediate b8=Q restores material. Kd2, Kc3 and Kb4 handle the strong checks, and Kb4 keeps c4 under the king’s protection after the final check.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Nineteen of 22 roots allow Qe2#, including immediate promotion. Rb2 and Re3 are inferior in the all-root comparison. After Qxf3, queen promotion is the only sound root. Kf2 and Kd1 are viable after Qxe4+, but independent cached 1M-node all-root probes show continued strong checks and repetition resources. After the played Qxd5+, only Kc3 holds within the playable score band. After Qd4+, only Kb4 holds, while Kc2 and Kb3 lose the knight or concede a decisive advantage.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxf3 is a strongest acceptance. Qh1+ and Qg1+ are strong checking declines and were covered. Qxe4+ is strongest after promotion. After Kd2, Qxd5+ is the strongest checked branch. After Kc3, Qd4+ requires Kb4. From Kb4, the strongest quiet replies allow normal play, and the supplemental 1M-node all-root comparison after Qc5+ found both Kb3 and Kc3 hold. Qxc4+ allows Kxc4. Actual e4 allows several satisfactory White moves, including the played Qxd6. All legal replies were screened and every forcing check and capture received deeper coverage.
reviewNotes.level: Five necessary solver moves against the strongest played checking branch. The defining accepted sacrifice is the rook for bishop. The final king move removes the narrow check pressure and preserves the knight, with sustainable queen-and-knight compensation.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Georgiev–Jobava game, Russian Team Championship, Sochi, 4 May 2007, Jobava archive. Original FEN follows 53...Bxf3. All nine sample plies were played, then 58...e4 59.Qxd6. Qc5+ Kb3 is analysis.

reviews.reason: The e5 offer pulls the attacking queen onto the e-file. The checks bring the white king to e1 in the sample, and the fifth move Re8 pins the queen. The strongest quiet Rc8 reply leaves more than one holding continuation without a renewed mate.
reviews.distinctness: Pawn offer followed by two king-displacing checks and a rook pin of the mating queen. The selected batch-two Grischuk–Balakrishnan exercise 0d828ba178877b4e also starts with Qxg7# pending, but uses bishop interposition and queen exchange. This exercise stops it with an absolute pin after a decoy.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qxg7#. Trong phương án phân tích, Đen chiếu Qb1+. Sau Kf2, Đen đi e5 — Tốt từ e6 đến e5, chấp nhận mất Tốt để kéo Hậu trắng đến e5. Sau Qxe5, Đen chiếu Qb6+ rồi Qb5+. Khi Vua trắng về e1, Re8 ghim Hậu e5 vào Vua trắng. Hậu trắng không thể bắt ở g7 vì sẽ để Vua bị chiếu. Trong ván đấu, Đen đi e5 trước.
hintsVi: Đen có thể đưa Hậu trắng đến cột e bằng cách chấp nhận mất Tốt nào?
Khi Hậu trắng ở e5, các nước chiếu có thể đưa Vua trắng đến đâu để Xe đen ghim Hậu?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qd4 creates Qxg7#. Qb1+ interrupts it and places the white king on f2 in the reviewed branch. The pawn offer e5 is accepted by Qxe5, putting the attacker on the e-file but leaving Qxg7# pending. Qb6+ and Qb5+ precede the king's e1 landing in the selected branch. Only then does Re8 establish the absolute pin.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Independently replayed all 153 legal solver roots on the five steps. The original move order e5 is materially worse in the comparisons, at -157 nominal cp in a 3M-node MultiPV and -212 in a 4.5M restricted probe. Qa6+ is also inferior. After Qb1+ Kf2, e5 is the sole holding choice in the bound evidence. After acceptance, Qb6+ is the sound check. After Kf1, Qb5+ is the best reviewed continuation. After Ke1, Re8 resolves the mate and outperforms continuing checks. Ke2 or Kg3 instead of Kf1 changes the defensive route and may be met by a queen defence on g6.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Independently replayed all 83 legal opponent replies on the sample turns. Kf2 and Ke2 are both relevant after the first check. Qxe5 is the strongest acceptance; Qe3, Qc5 and Rxg7+ were also reviewed. Kf2 and Kg1 are alternatives to Ke1 after Qb5+; a separate 1M-node full-history probe after Kf2 confirms only Qb6+ holds, with the threat recurring until White varies. After the endpoint Re8 the strongest reply Rc8 is quiet and does not restore the mate threat. An additional 1.5M full-history probe finds Rxc8, Qa5+, Qb4+ and Qb1+ all within 26 nominal cp of the best (-116, -125, -141, -142). The immediate trade Rxc8 Qe6+ allows three comparably holding king moves in a 1M-node probe; after Kh7 Qf5+, g6, Kg8 and Kh8 are viable at 1.5M. The practical follow-up trades rooks into a queen ending with a pawn deficit and no pending mate.
reviewNotes.level: Five connected solver moves in the selected strong branch. The one-pawn sacrifice is genuine, and securing the pin requires coordinating the queen checks with the rook. Rc8 changes the ensuing play to rook exchange or ordinary checks, with several viable continuations rather than a single critical sixth move.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed all 103 plies of Chigorin–Salwe, Lodz 1906, from the PGN Mentor Chigorin archive. White played 29.Qd4. Black played 29...e5 before Qb1+, whereas the exercise begins with the analytical move order 29...Qb1+. The copy identifies this clearly.

reviews.reason: The exchange sacrifice removes the checking knight. Rc1 prepares the first pawn recovery with check, then gxf5 restores material balance. The strongest rook check still makes the fifth move Kf8 necessary before the position becomes an ordinary rook ending.
reviews.distinctness: Exchange sacrifice against a knight check followed by two pawn recoveries. The defending rook prepares the first capture with tempo, while the king must occupy the passed pawn's promotion square after the final check.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen đang bị chiếu. Trong phương án phân tích, Đen đi Rxf6 — Xe từ f5 đến f6, bắt Mã. Sau gxf6, Đen đi Rc1, chuẩn bị bắt Tốt c3 kèm chiếu. Trắng đi f5, Đen đáp Rxc3+. Sau Kf4, Đen bắt Tốt thứ hai bằng gxf5. Trắng chiếu Rg7+, Đen đáp Kf8, chiếm ô phong cấp của Tốt trắng f6. Trong ván đấu, Đen đi Kf8 ngay ở nước 40.
hintsVi: Nếu Vua đen đi Kh8, Xe trắng có thể chiếu hết ở đâu?
Sau khi Trắng bắt Xe ở f6, Xe đen còn lại có thể chuẩn bị bắt Tốt nào kèm chiếu?
Sau Rg7+, Vua đen có thể đứng ở đâu để chặn đường phong cấp của Tốt f6?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White's Nf6+ checks Black. Kh8 permits Rh7#. Rxf6 removes the checking knight, and gxf6 accepts the exchange offer, giving White the advanced f6 pawn. Rc1 prepares Rxc3+ against f5. The checking capture regains one pawn and the g-pawn takes the second by gxf5. After Rg7+, Kf8 occupies f8, the promotion square of the white f-pawn.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Independently replayed all 51 legal solver roots on the five sample steps. The original Kf8 is inferior in the initial bounded comparison. Rg1+, Ra3, a3 and Kf8 are other practical replies after gxf6, but the supplied shorter comparisons show no equivalent quicker recovery. Rc1 is the top screened plan and turns the pawn capture into a check. After f5, immediate gxf5 is weaker than Rxc3+. After Kf4, gxf5 is the only holding move in the supplied comparisons. After Rg7+, full-history 1M all-root evidence gives Kf8 -7 nominal cp and Kh8 -412.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Independently replayed all 82 opponent replies across the sample turns. The strongest acceptance gxf6 is much stronger than any decline. Reviewed f5, c4, Kg4 and checking alternatives after Rc1. Once both pawns are recovered, a 1.5M full-history reply probe confirms Rg7+, Ra8+ and f7+ are comparable. Ra8+ has three legal evasions and only Kf7 holds in a 1.25M all-root probe; it is a credible fifth-decision branch. f7+ allows Kf8 or Kg7. For the submitted Rg7+ Kf8 branch, an added 1.25M full-history comparison has twelve leading quiet continuations around equality. Subsequent ordinary rook checks, including the weaker immediate Rg8+ and Rf7+, do not restart a concrete mate or material-loss sequence. Material has returned to balance.
reviewNotes.level: Five connected solver moves in the analyzed strong branch. Rc1 is the concrete setup for recovering both pawns and survives the other verified branches. The fifth move matters against the comparable rook check because the other king move loses decisively. Its endpoint has ordinary rook-endgame play.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed all 130 plies of Erigaisi–Salimiyan, Titled Tuesday October 2026, from TWIC 1667. White played 40.Nf6+, then Black played 40...Kf8. The entire Rxf6 line is analysis at that exact position.

reviews.reason: Five White moves meet the two mating threats. The accepted queen sacrifice sustains the counterchecks, and the second rook must recover the knight after the strongest recaptures on h5.
reviews.distinctness: The queen offer displaces the bishop, then the two rooks handle different tasks. One removes the mating queen and is taken. The other captures the knight to secure a balanced rook ending. The accepted countercheck examples in the previous batch use minor-piece offers or capture a mating rook, with different recovery.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qxd1# và Rh1#. Trắng đi 32.Qg8+ Kh6 rồi thí Hậu bằng 33.Qh8+. Sau 33...Bxh8 34.Rxh8+, ván đấu tiếp tục 34...Kg7. Trong nhánh phân tích 34...Kg5, Trắng đi 35.Rxh5+ để bắt Hậu. Sau 35...Rxh5, Trắng đi 36.Rxd2, bắt Mã và đưa thế cờ về tàn cuộc mỗi bên còn một Xe và bốn Tốt.
hintsVi: Trắng có thể dùng nước chiếu nào để giành thời gian trước hai đòn chiếu hết?
Sau khi Tượng đen đến h8, Xe nào có thể chiếu tiếp rồi bắt Hậu đen? Xe còn lại có thể thu hồi quân nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White faces Qxd1# and Rh1#. Qg8+ gains tempo, and Qh8+ offers the queen to draw the bishop onto h8. Rxh8+ keeps Black in check and makes Rxh5+ possible against Kg5. Rxd2 recovers the knight after the first rook is taken and completes the compensation.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Independent replay found 35 of 42 legal starting moves allow immediate mate and the stored all-root analysis rates the other alternatives decisively inferior. The strongest alternative f3 scores -543, compared with zero for Qg8+. Qh8+ and Rxh8+ are the only sound moves at the second and third turns. Rxh5+ is the only playable fourth move after Kg5. After Rxh5, Kxh5 or gxh5, separate exact-cache all-root probes find Rxd2 the only playable fifth move, at -1, +3 and +7 respectively.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kh6 is the only answer to Qg8+. Bxh8 is the strongest acceptance of Qh8+, and both Kg7 and Kg5 are equally serious after Rxh8+. In the played Kg7 branch Rxh5 has strong Rd4, Rxh5 and gxh5 replies. After Rd4, the played Rh3 and analysis Rxd2 both hold in the independent all-root comparison. Rxd2 Rxd2 leaves rook and four pawns each and multiple playable sixth moves. In the sample branch Rxd2 leaves the same nominal material balance. The only immediate check Rh1+ gives up the rook to Kxh1, while strongest Kf6 allows Kf1, Rd3, Rd7 or f3. The sample endpoint and the strong played branch need no additional forced recovery.
reviewNotes.level: Five necessary solver moves in the selected strongest branch. The accepted queen sacrifice and the later rook capture are connected by checks. The fifth move secures a stable rook ending, with the remaining activity comparable to ordinary endgame play.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Mamedyarov–Corrales Jimenez game, PRO League Group Stage, 13 March 2019, Mamedyarov archive. Original FEN follows 31...Qh5. The first five sample plies were played. The game continued 34...Kg7 35.Rxh5 Rd4 36.Rh3. The sample from 34...Kg5 and the alternative recovery after Rd4 are analysis.

reviews.reason: Capture with check, draw the f-pawn forward, then sacrifice the queen to remove the bishop supporting mate. The rook recaptures and ends the attack.
reviews.distinctness: The queen is offered to the bishop on h6 rather than captured by a mating rook or pawn. A check from d6 diverts the f-pawn before the offer.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qg7#. Đen đi 26...Rxe1+ — Xe đen từ e5 bắt Xe ở e1 và chiếu Vua. Sau 27.Kh2, Đen chiếu 27...Qd6+, buộc Trắng đẩy 28.f4. Đen thí Hậu bằng 28...Qf8 để kéo Tượng trắng khỏi h6. Sau 29.Bxf8, Đen bắt lại bằng 29...Rxf8. Tượng không còn bảo vệ g7 và hai Xe đen phối hợp chống Hậu trắng.
hintsVi: Hậu trắng dọa chiếu hết ở g7 nhờ Tượng h6. Đen có thể lấy nhịp bằng nước bắt quân nào?
Sau khi Tốt f2 tiến lên, quân nào có thể kéo Tượng khỏi đường chéo h6–g7?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qg7# is enabled by Bh6. Rxe1+ buys time and removes White’s rook. Qd6+ forces f4, allowing Qf8 to offer the queen to the mating bishop. Rxf8 removes that support and keeps Black’s king sheltered.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All roots and replies were replayed. The non-checking alternatives to Rxe1+ allow Qg7#. After Kh2, direct Rh1+ loses the rook and Qc7+ fails to f4. Qxf4+ after f4 loses the queen without removing Bh6. Taking Bxf8 with the king permits Qh8+ and Qxh7, and a 1.25M-node recheck drops Black to about equality.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kh2 and f4 are the only legal replies in their frames. Bxf8 is the strong capture. The net cost at the acceptance is a queen, followed by Rxf8, with two rooks versus queen and the preceding captured rook making the sequence sound. Qe7 at the endpoint is quiet and the 1.25M-node comparison supports several Black replies. No residual mating resource requires a fifth decision.
reviewNotes.level: Four connected solver moves. Rxe1+ and Qd6+ precede the queen offer. Black must still recapture to restore the material balance and stop the supported mate.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Arizmendi Martinez, Julen Luis–Anand, Viswanathan game, Villarrobledo op, 1998.08.22. Replayed the archived preceding Qxf6 and exact FEN at ply 51. Source https://www.pgnmentor.com/players/Anand.zip. The bound line was played in full.

reviews.reason: The bishop block interrupts the queen check. White then deliberately leaves the bishop to the knight and trades queens, removing the active checking piece. The strongest alternative acceptance also leaves a sound fifth-move response.
reviews.distinctness: A bishop is offered to draw the knight away after it checks, then the defending queen eliminates the attacking queen by an equal exchange. Unlike the bishop block in 0d828ba178877b4e, the knight accepts the offer in the game and the queen captures rather than interposing.
reviews.solutionVi: 35.Rxf2 — Xe trắng từ f1 bắt Xe đang chiếu ở f2. Sau 35...Qxf2+ 36.Kh3 Qf5+, Trắng dùng Tượng chắn chiếu bằng 37.Bg4. Đen chiếu 37...Nf2+, Trắng đi 38.Kg2 và để Đen bắt Tượng bằng 38...Nxg4. Trắng đổi Hậu bằng 39.Qxf5 gxf5, chấm dứt đợt chiếu của Hậu đen.
hintsVi: Hãy xác định Xe đen đang chiếu từ đâu. Nếu Vua trắng đi g1, Đen sẽ chiếu hết ở ô nào?
Sau khi Tượng trắng chắn chiếu ở g4, hãy tính cách đưa Vua đến ô an toàn và đổi Hậu khi Mã đen bắt Tượng.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rxf2 is required to avoid Qh2#. Kh3 evades the second check. Bg4 blocks the f5–h3 diagonal, and after Nf2+ the king chooses g2. Nxg4 then permits Qxf5, eliminating the queen checking sequence.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Independently replayed all legal roots and immediate mate replies at all five frames. At the initial check Kg1 allows Qh2#. Kh1 is decisively inferior after Qxf2+. The sound retreats Kh2 and Kg2 against Qf5+ allow Qf2+ and return to the same pressure. Kg3 against Nf2+ also permits a return to the same decision after Ne4+ Kh3 Nf2+. The fifth move Qxf5 is strongest, while Be3 allows Nxe3+ Nxe3 Qg5+ and continued checking. No shorter safe endpoint.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After Bg4, the bishop is protected against immediate Qxg4+ Kxg4. The strong Nf2+ changes the relationships. Kg2 permits Nxg4, an actual bishop loss, while Qxf5 gxf5 trades queens and keeps a playable ending. The temporary 930-point snapshot is not a material gain claim. In the comparable Qxg4+ branch, supplemental all-root analysis favors Kxf2. The strongest ensuing Qh4+ has seven viable legal evasions, led by Ke2, so this alternate check does not require a new precise sixth defence.
reviewNotes.level: Five connected solver decisions. The initial rook exchange is even. The bishop offer has a separate role in bringing about the terminal queen exchange. All strongest replies after the played Qxf5 were checked.
reviewNotes.provenance: Donner–Geller, Bled 1961 round 14, PGN Mentor Geller archive. Complete source replay reaches the original FEN after 34...Rf2+. The entire bound line through 39.Qxf5 and the following 39...gxf5 were played.

reviews.reason: Five moves give up the exchange to stop immediate mate, then force a queen trade against the strongest pawn check to reach a stable ending.
reviews.distinctness: The pawn one square from promotion belongs to the attacker. Black removes it with the queen and must recapture the opposing queen with the king. Vorotnikov–Kholmov and Georgiev–Jobava promote the solver’s pawn, while Nikolic–Wohl uses a rook to protect the solver’s promotion.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen thí Xe bằng 23...Rf7 để chặn đường chiếu của Tượng. Sau 24.Bxf7+ Kxf7 25.Qh5+ Kg8, ván đấu tiếp tục 26.Kxg2. Trong nhánh phân tích 26.f7+, Đen đi 26...Qxf7, bắt Tốt sắp phong cấp. Sau 27.Qxf7+ Kxf7, hai Hậu đã rời bàn và đòn tấn công được hóa giải.
hintsVi: Nếu Vua đen đi Kh8 ngay, Tốt trắng có thể chiếu hết ở ô nào?
Sau f7+, Đen có thể bắt Tốt bằng quân nào để đổi Hậu?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rf7 interposes against the e6-bishop and allows Bxf7+ to take the rook. Kxf7 recovers the bishop. Against the strong Qh5+, Kg8 is the only sound response. White can then play f7+, and Qxf7 Qxf7+ Kxf7 removes both the promotion threat and the attacking queen.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Kh8 initially allows fxg7#. After Bxf7+, only Kxf7 holds. After Qh5+, Kg8 is the only viable king route in the all-root comparison. After f7+, Kh8 and Kf8 are decisively inferior to Qxf7. After Qxf7+, Kh8 loses to Bxg7#, leaving Kxf7 as the sole defence.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After the initial rook sacrifice, Bxf7+ is strongest. After Kxf7, both Kxg2 and Qh5+ are strong. Kxg2 permits several viable answers in the supplementary 1M-node all-root review, including Qe4+ and Qxd4. The source played Kxg2 later after Kg8, and that branch also allows Qe4+ or Qxd4. The strong f7+ branch requires the full queen exchange. After Kxf7, the strong replies are quiet. All-root evidence after Bxa7 finds Rd2, Bc6, Bf3 and other sound options, and the forcing Rf1+ gives up the rook to Bxf1.
reviewNotes.level: Five necessary moves against the chosen strong branch. The first rook is exchanged for a bishop at a material loss. The last two solver moves trade queens and leave a stable rook-and-bishop ending.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Kramnik–Szpar game, Titled Tuesday early, 18 April 2023, Kramnik archive. Original FEN follows 23.Bxe6+. The first five sample plies were played. The source then chose 26.Kxg2 Qe4+. The submitted branch from 26.f7+ is analysis.

reviews.reason: The exchange sacrifice removes the checking knight. The queen then attacks the bishop and repositions with check to recover it on the fourth move. The opponent's strongest final replies lead to ordinary play with more than one sound response.
reviews.distinctness: The exchange sacrifice is compensated by a queen maneuver that captures the bishop. Unlike the similar Salimiyan exchange sacrifice, the recovery uses a queen check and bishop capture rather than recovering pawns and blockading promotion.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng đang bị chiếu. Trắng đi Rxf3 — Xe từ e3 đến f3, bắt Mã. Sau Bxf3, phương án phân tích dùng Qe3 để tấn công Tượng. Khi Đen đi Bxg4, Trắng chiếu Qd4+, đưa Hậu lên cùng hàng với Tượng g4. Sau Kg8, Trắng bắt Tượng bằng Qxg4, thu lại vật chất đã bỏ ra để phòng thủ. Trong ván đấu, Trắng đi g5 sau Bxf3.
hintsVi: Nếu Vua trắng đi Kh1, Xe đen có thể chiếu hết bằng nước nào?
Sau khi Tượng đen đến g4, Hậu trắng có thể chiếu từ ô nào để chuẩn bị bắt Tượng?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Black's Nxf3+ checks White. Kh1 allows Rxh2#, while Kf1 is losing in the bounded search. Rxf3 removes the knight and accepts Bxf3. Qe3 attacks the bishop. After Bxg4, Qd4+ brings the queen onto the bishop's rank with tempo. Qxg4 restores the sacrificed material.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Independently replayed all 89 solver roots on the four sample turns. Rxf3 is the only holding initial response in the supplied comparison. Qe5+, the played g5 and Qe3 are all viable after Bxf3. The earlier five-move sample had a shorter witness in Qe3, now selected and fully reviewed. Qxb6 and a3 after Bxg4 are other practical choices, but neither secures the same bishop recovery within three solver moves.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Independently replayed all 91 legal replies on the four sample turns. Bxf3 accepts the exchange sacrifice; Rc1+ and Be6 declines are inferior. After Qe3, both Bxg4 and Rg2+ are strong. Additional 1M exact-history review finds Kf1 +34 and Kh1 -848 after Rg2+; Rxa2 Qxf3 recovers on the fourth move, and strongest Rxh2 is quiet. In the submitted line after Qd4+, Kg8, Kf8 and Kh6 all allow Qxg4. After the final capture, Rxa2 is a quiet practical reply and Rc1+ is comparable. Added 850k all-root analysis after Rc1+ finds two sound evasions Kf2 +19 and Kg2 +14, while Qd1 is inferior. The exchange recovery is secured and the remaining rook checks are ordinary.
reviewNotes.level: Four connected solver moves with an accepted exchange sacrifice and a checking queen maneuver for recovery. Neither the final capture nor the strongest alternate queen recovery needs another critical defensive move.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed all 79 plies of Erigaisi–Carlsen, Speed Chess 2024, from the PGN Mentor Carlsen archive. Black played 29...Nxf3+. The game matches through 30.Rxf3 Bxf3. White then played 31.g5, so the sample starting 31.Qe3 is explicitly analytical.

reviews.reason: The rook sacrifice draws the king away from g2. The queen gains a checking tempo to reach g6, where it guards both mating squares.
reviews.distinctness: Two rook counterchecks form a decoy sacrifice, then a pawn capture with check lets the queen defend two adjacent squares with a quiet move. Unlike the published queen offers and promotions, the rook buys a tempo specifically to transfer the queen to g6.
reviews.solutionVi: 23...Re1+ — Xe đen từ e5 đến e1, chiếu Vua. Sau 24.Kf2, Đen thí Xe bằng 24...Re2+ để kéo Vua trắng đến e2. Ván đấu tiếp tục 25.Kxe2 Qxg2+. Trong phương án phân tích, sau 26.Ke1, Đen đi 26...Qg6 để khống chế cả f6 lẫn f5. Nếu Trắng chiếu Qf6+, Đen có thể đổi Hậu bằng Qxf6 rồi bắt lại Xe sau Rxf6+.
hintsVi: Trắng dọa chiếu hết ở f6. Nếu Vua trắng đứng ở f2, vì sao Đen chưa thể bắt Tốt g2 an toàn?
Sau khi Hậu đen bắt Tốt ở g2, tìm ô để Hậu bảo vệ cả f5 và f6.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White threatens Qf6# and, after Kf2, Qf5#. Re1+ brings the king to f2. Re2+ draws it to e2, preventing Kxg2 after Qxg2+. The queen can then travel from g2 to g6 and protect f6 horizontally and f5 diagonally.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Independently replayed all 34 initial roots and all later roots and immediate mating replies. Immediate Qxg2+ is decisively inferior, and after Kf2 it specifically fails to Kxg2. Re2+ is the sole viable second move. Qxg2+ is the sole viable third move. After the strong Ke1, every alternative to Qg6 is inferior or allows mate. The extra checking route Qg1+ in the actual game is unnecessary in the saved branch.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Kxe2 is the strongest acceptance and costs a full rook without an immediate recapture. The queen captures g2 with check and reaches g6. Verified Qf6+ Qxf6 Rxf6+ Kxf6 and Qf5+ Qxf5 Rxf5 Kxf5. Both strongest endpoint replies Rc7 and Rxb7 are quiet, with sound bounded continuations. The queen can also reach g6 against the competing strong Ke3 and Kd1 replies to Qxg2+.
reviewNotes.level: Four necessary solver moves. The accepted rook sacrifice creates the queen transfer and the terminal quiet move answers both renewed mating threats. No shorter viable defence was found.
reviewNotes.provenance: Bluebaum–Moroni, 1st 3-0 Thursday 14 May 2026 round 6, The Week in Chess 1645. Complete source replay reaches the exact FEN after 23.Qf4. The source played the line through 25...Qxg2+. The chosen 26.Ke1 Qg6 is analysis. In the game White chose 26.Kd1 and Black played Qg1+ Kd2 Qg6.

reviews.reason: White moves away from two mating squares, then must select the safer of two king retreats against the strong supported Qg2+ check.
reviews.distinctness: Both Qg2# and Qh1# are live at the start. Unlike active Nguyen Hoang Nam–George, which uses Kf1 then an equal queen interposition against Qh1+, this defence uses a second king move toward the centre and avoids a material loss on d1.
reviews.solutionVi: 21.Kf1 — Vua trắng từ g1 đến f1 để tránh hai đe dọa Qg2# và Qh1#. Trong ván đấu, Đen đáp 21...h5. Nếu Đen chiếu 21...Qg2+ như trong phương án phân tích, Trắng đi 22.Ke2. Đi 22.Ke1 cho phép 22...Bf3, đe dọa bắt Xe trắng ở d1.
hintsVi: Hậu và Tượng đen phối hợp dọa chiếu hết ở g2 và h1. Vua trắng có thể đi đâu để tránh cả hai đe dọa?
Sau Qg2+, hãy so sánh e1 và e2. Tượng đen có thể tấn công Xe d1 từ ô nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The black bishop on c6 supports the queen along c6–d5–e4–f3–g2. Kf1 changes both mating threats into possible checks. Qg2+ then calls for Ke2. Ke1 permits Bf3, threatening the d1-rook.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Independently replayed all 37 legal starting moves and both responses to Qg2+. Thirty of the 36 alternatives permit immediate mate. Direct Qe4 is sound only with further action: strongest Qxe4 renews both mates, requiring dxe4. Qh4+ g5 also leaves more work. Direct f3 is inferior under the targeted Qxf3 comparison. Ke1 after Qg2+ is decisively worse than Ke2.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Supplemental 2.4-million-node comparison found Qg2+ within 40 centipawns of the strongest quiet Kf8 after Kf1. The source’s h5 is also strong and leaves quiet play. After Ke2 the strongest Kf8 renews no mate or forcing check, and the additional relevant quiet replies do not require another defensive decision. Qxf2+ allows Kxf2, Qxg3 allows several captures, and the unprotected h2 capture is clearly inferior to Kf8. No credible material offer.
reviewNotes.level: Exactly two connected solver moves against the strong checking branch. The second is necessary to preserve the position, and the endpoint withstands the strongest replies.
reviewNotes.provenance: Xu–Wang, Chinese League B, Shaoxing 2026 round 3.1, The Week in Chess 1656. Complete replay reached the exact FEN after 20...Qd5. 21.Kf1 was played, followed by 21...h5. Qg2+ Ke2 is verified analysis.

reviews.reason: The rook protects d3. When the queen renews the attack on f2, a countercheck vacates f4 as an escape square.
reviews.distinctness: The two mating squares are guarded by different resources. The second move frees a square previously occupied by White’s own queen.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qd3#. Trắng đi 44.Rad1 — Xe từ a1 đến d1 để khống chế d3. Trong ván đấu, Đen chuyển sang dọa Qf2# bằng 44...Qc2. Trắng đáp 45.Qf7+, vừa chiếu Vua đen vừa dọn ô f4 cho Vua trắng. Nếu Hậu đen tiếp tục chiếu ở f2, Vua trắng có thể thoát qua f4.
hintsVi: Xe nào có thể bảo vệ d3 mà vẫn giữ Xe còn lại trên cột e?
Nếu Hậu đen chuyển sang c2, Hậu trắng có thể dọn ô thoát nào cho Vua bằng một nước chiếu?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rad1 protects d3 against the initial mate. After the strong Qc2, the new threat is Qf2#. Qf7+ both clears f4 and gives check, turning Qf2# into a check with a viable escape.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All legal roots were independently replayed. Qf6 is comparable and also needs a second decision against the 1.2M-node joint-strongest Qd3+, where only Kf4 is mate-safe. The quiet Rh2 response is also comparable. Qf6 is an alternative preparation rather than an established one-move defence against all strong replies.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: The strongest first replies include the quiet Qg6, Qg8 and Rxb2. The played Qc2 is inside the full reply window and is the immediate renewed threat. After Qf7+, Kd6 is the stronger king reply and the played Kd8 is also legal. The original mating net is dismantled after both, and Kf4 and Rf1 remain viable under 1.2M comparisons. The rook captures are ordinary and no viable unequal offer was identified at either step.
reviewNotes.level: The first move covers the original mating square, then the second changes the escape geometry against a credible response. Initial material favors White, but legal routine moves allow immediate mate. The purpose is preserving the position.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Anand,V–Adly,A game from Online Olym Top DivB 2021, 2021.09.08, https://www.pgnmentor.com/players/Anand.zip. Verified unmodified FEN at ply 86 and preceding move Qh7. The full saved sample was played.

reviews.reason: The same bishop first removes the support of mate on e8, then interposes on f8 when the queen changes checking squares.
reviews.distinctness: The bishop returns from h6 to f8 to shield the king. The moving defender first exchanges a bishop, then cuts the queen’s checking line.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qe8#. Đen đi 27...Bxh6 — Tượng từ g5 bắt Tượng trắng ở h6, cắt đường bảo vệ ô f8. Trong phương án phân tích, Trắng chiếu 28.Qc8+ và Đen đáp 28...Bf8 để chặn đường chiếu. Nếu Trắng bắt Tượng bằng 29.Qxf8+, Vua đen bắt lại Hậu bằng 29...Kxf8. Trong ván đấu, Trắng chọn 28.Bb7.
hintsVi: Tượng trắng h6 đang kiểm soát ô thoát nào của Vua đen?
Sau khi bắt Tượng h6, Tượng đen có thể trở về ô nào để chặn Qc8+?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The bishop on h6 controls f8 so Qe8 would be mate. Bxh6 frees f8 and stops that net. Qc8+ then tests the same bishop, which can cover the eighth rank from f8.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All roots and replies were replayed. Bxh6 is the only adequate starting move. On the checking branch Bf8 and Kg7 both hold, while Qd8 is inferior. The quiet b3 is also a credible first reply, and the analysed Qc8+ remained within 39 nominal cp in the 1.2M recheck.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Bf8 can be taken only by giving up White’s queen to Kxf8. The other new pawn captures either drop material immediately or allow equal recaptures. The strongest endpoint b3 is quiet, and the separate Kg7 endpoint is likewise quiet in the 1.2M comparison.
reviewNotes.level: Two connected non-sacrificial decisions against a credible check. The second interposition is a clean endpoint and preserves both material and king safety.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Krudde, Fitzgerald–Kortschnoj, Viktor game from NLD-chT, 1993.??.??, https://www.pgnmentor.com/players/Korchnoi.zip. Verified unmodified FEN at ply 53 and preceding move Qxd7. The game continued Bxh6 Bb7 b3. The different sample continuation is teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: Capture the rook that supports mate, then interpose the queen on a square protected by the king.
reviews.distinctness: The learner chooses between interposition squares on the back rank after taking the supporting rook. The square f1 works because the king protects it.
reviews.solutionVi: Đen dọa Qxg2#. Trắng đi 35.Qxe2 — Hậu từ e1 bắt Xe ở e2, loại quân đang bảo vệ g2. Sau 35...Qb1+, trong phương án phân tích Trắng đi 36.Qf1 để chặn chiếu. Vua g1 bảo vệ Hậu ở f1, còn nếu chặn bằng 36.Qd1 thì Đen bắt Hậu mà Trắng không thể bắt lại. Trong ván đấu, Trắng chọn 36.Kf2.
hintsVi: Quân đen nào đang bảo vệ ô g2?
Nếu Hậu đen chiếu ở b1, Hậu trắng có thể chặn chiếu trên ô nào được Vua bảo vệ?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qxe2 takes the rook guarding g2, so the immediate Qxg2 mating capture fails. The strongest Qb1+ exploits the back rank from a different square. Qf1 blocks with king support.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qxe2 is the only adequate starting root. Qb1+ is the strongest full-budget response. After it, Qf1 and the actual Kf2 both hold. Qd1 loses to Qxd1+ as verified by the 1.2M-node probe.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxf1+ is an equal queen exchange after Kxf1, with no net concession. The new stationary pawn captures have adequate recaptures and are inferior. At the endpoint the strongest 1.2M reply Qe4 is quiet and Qxf1+ is far weaker.
reviewNotes.level: The rook capture and then the protected interposition are two connected decisions. The sample analysis chooses the queen interposition while the game chose the king move.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Aronian,L–Nakamura,Hi game from 6th Norway Blitz 2018, 2018.05.27, https://www.pgnmentor.com/players/Aronian.zip. Verified exact FEN at ply 68 and preceding move Rxe2. The game continued Qxe2 Qb1+ Kf2. The differing sample is teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: Re8 covers the original mate on e7. Nef4 creates a new mate on f6, which Nxf4+ stops with a countercheck and a sound exchange.
reviews.distinctness: The active Aronian–Caruana exercise takes an already checking knight. Here the opponent first makes a quiet move to block the queen’s defensive file, and Black takes that interposing knight with check.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Ne7#. Trong phương án phân tích, Đen đi 32...Re8 để bảo vệ e7. Trắng đi 33.Nef4, chặn đường Hậu đen đến f6 và dọa Nf6#. Đen đáp 33...Nxf4+, bắt Mã ở f4 và chiếu lại. Nếu Trắng bắt bằng Qxf4, Đen có thể đổi Hậu bằng Qxf4. Trong ván đấu, Đen chọn 32...Qf1+.
hintsVi: Xe đen có thể đứng ở đâu để bắt Mã nếu Trắng chiếu Ne7+?
Sau Nef4, quân nào đang chắn đường Hậu đen đến f6? Đen có thể bắt quân đó và chiếu lại không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Re8 covers e7 against Ne7#. Nef4 places the e2-knight on f4, cutting off the black queen’s path from f2 to f6 and creating Nf6#. Nxf4+ takes that knight with tempo and leaves sound material outcomes against each capture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Twenty-six of 35 initial moves permit immediate mate. Qf1+ is a viable delaying alternative, but the independent all-root probe found only Kh4 in reply and the same Ne7# threat. Re8 is then the sole playable Black move and Nef4 can renew the attack. The actual Ne5 allows Ne7#. After the submitted Re8 Nef4, the all-root comparison strongly favors Nxf4+ over Qf1+, Qd4 and Qb2.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Nef4 is the strongest reply after Re8, with quiet Qg5 also credible and Ne7+ answered by Rxe7. After Nxf4+, the strongest Qxf4 permits Qxf4 gxf4, an equal queen exchange following the knight exchange. Independent 1M-node all-root analysis then finds several sound moves, including Kg7, Kf8 and Kh8. Nxf4 allows Rxe4. The pawn capture gxf4 gives equal nominal knight material and is refuted by Qf3+ Kh4 Qg4#, verified against all legal replies. The pre-existing pawn capture Qxh5 after Re8 loses the queen to the checked continuation Qf1+ Kh4 gxh5. All forcing replies received deeper coverage.
reviewNotes.level: Two solver decisions against a strong branch with distinct mating threats. The knight and queen exchanges remain materially sound. The endpoint no longer requires a narrow defence.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Gukesh–Carlsen game, Speed Chess, 6 December 2022, Carlsen archive. Original position follows 32.Kh3. The game continued 32...Qf1+ 33.Kh4 Ne5 34.Ne7#. The full submitted Re8 line is analysis.

reviews.reason: Guard the mating square with the queen, then use a pawn to complete the exchange under check.
reviews.distinctness: A queen protects the mating square and invites the exchange. The solver must recapture under check rather than leave the opposing queen on the board.
reviews.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qg7#. Đen đi 35...Qg6 — Hậu từ b1 đến g6, bảo vệ g7 và mời đổi Hậu. Sau 36.Qxg6+, Đen bắt lại bằng 36...hxg6 như trong ván đấu. Đen cũng có thể dùng Tốt f7 bắt lại ở g6. Nếu Vua đi 36...Kf8, Trắng chiếu 37.Qxd6+ và giữ Hậu.
hintsVi: Hậu đen có thể bảo vệ g7 từ ô nào để mời đổi Hậu?
Khi Trắng bắt Hậu ở g6 và chiếu, quân nào của Đen có thể bắt lại?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qg6 guards g7, so Qg7+ is answered by Qxg7. White’s Qxg6+ forces the issue.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Qg6 is the only adequate opening. Both hxg6 and fxg6 keep the same defensive objective. Kf8 instead is refuted by Qxd6+ in the 1.2M probe.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxg6+ is strongest. The exact recapture restores the full queen balance. After hxg6, the deepest reply is the quiet Rxa3, and the h-pawn check is inferior with several legal king replies. No viable unequal offer exists.

Sau Qb8+, hãy so sánh việc đưa Vua ra khỏi đường chiếu với việc dùng Hậu để chắn.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White threatens Qh8# along the b2–h8 diagonal. The knight on d5 covers e7. Qxd5 takes it and frees the e7 flight square. A strong Qb8+ still requires choosing a safe king retreat.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Nine of 20 initial roots allow immediate mate, and the others apart from Qxd5 are decisively inferior in the all-root comparison. Qb8+ has three legal answers. Ke7 and Kg7 hold, while Qd8 allows Qxd8+ and loses the queen. The equally strong passed-pawn advance a6 also requires an accurate second decision. Independent 1M-node analysis found Qa5 and Qc5 playable, with the next move h4 appreciably worse.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Strong checks after Qxd5 include Qb8+, Qb4+, Qh8+ and Qa3+. Qg7+ loses the queen to Kxg7. At the endpoint, independent 1M-node comparisons found several near-equal answers to both Qb4+ and Qc7+. The alternate Kg7 also holds against Qb2+ and quiet replies. All forcing checks and captures were reviewed, and no new pawn or stationary material offer follows either sample move.
reviewNotes.level: Two simple decisions combine removal of a mating support with a king retreat. The endpoint permits ordinary queen-endgame play, including multiple safe answers to later checks. No sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Complete Volkov–Aronian game, Titled Tuesday late, 1 August 2023, Aronian archive. Original position follows 43.Nxd5. The game played 43...Qxd5 44.a6. The direct 44.Qb8+ Ke7 branch is analysis.

deferred.reason: Editorially eligible reserve. Held for a later Level B selection to keep the current batch distinct.
deferred.distinctness: Two successive changes to control of the same mating square. The attacking pawn is removed, the opposing knight replaces it, and the defending knight then guards the square. Active 17eea2ef8252bafd instead switches between two mating squares and uses a pawn block.
deferred.solutionVi: Trắng dọa Qxh7#. Đen đi hxg6 — Tốt từ h7 bắt Tốt trắng ở g6, loại quân đang bảo vệ h7. Trong phương án phân tích, Trắng đi Ng5, đưa Mã đến bảo vệ h7 và lại dọa Qh7#. Đen đáp Nf6 — Mã từ d7 đến f6, giữ ô h7. Nếu Hậu trắng chiếu Qh7+, Mã đen bắt Hậu bằng Nxh7. Trong ván đấu, Trắng đi Rc2 trước, Đen đáp Nf6 rồi Trắng mới đi Ng5.
hintsVi: Quân trắng nào đang bảo vệ h7? Đen có thể bắt quân đó bằng Tốt nào?
Nếu Mã trắng đến g5 để bảo vệ h7, Mã đen có thể đến đâu để bắt Hậu trên h7?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: White's hxg6 puts the pawn on g6 where it guards h7, enabling Qxh7#. Black's hxg6 removes that guard and empties h7. White Ng5 replaces the guard and makes Qh7# pending again. Nf6 defends h7, and the concrete Qh7+ Nxh7 is legal.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Independently replayed all 71 legal solver roots across the two steps. Thirty-one of 38 initial moves permit mate in one. The other pawn capture fxg6 is weaker than hxg6 in the bound evidence and in a 2.5M two-root probe (-206 vs -126 nominal cp). After hxg6 Ng5, 30 of 33 legal moves allow Qh7#. Nf6 is the sound choice in the bound review and scores -120 in a full-history 5M restricted probe. Re8 gave fluctuating lower-budget scores and was -193 in a 3.2M two-root comparison. These comparisons do not establish an exhaustive uniqueness claim.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Independently replayed all 76 legal replies across the two sample turns. After hxg6, a full-history 1.5M comparison ties Ng5 with the played Rc2 (-149 nominal cp). Only Ng5 immediately restores the mate threat, so this is a relevant branch requiring a second decision. After Nf6, 1.5M finds quiet Rc2 and Rcd1 at -136 and -108. A 4.5M targeted reply comparison gives quiet Rcd1 -115 and Rc2 -111. No moved or stationary unequal offer was found. Nxf7 allows Rxf7, and Qh7+ allows the knight to take the queen. Material has improved by the captured pawn, with no further critical defence at the endpoint.
reviewNotes.level: Two linked solver moves against a comparably strongest reply, with a renewed mate on h7 and an uncomplicated knight defence. The analysis endpoint withstands the reviewed strongest quiet replies.
reviewNotes.provenance: Replayed all 88 plies of Polgar–Gelfand, George Marx Rapid 2003, from the PGN Mentor Gelfand archive. White played 20.hxg6 and Black played 20...hxg6. The game continued 21.Rc2 Nf6 22.Ng5. The analyzed 21.Ng5 Nf6 22.Rc2 reaches the same FEN, and the Vietnamese copy labels the changed move order.

reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After Nxd8 Nxe5, the 1.2M comparison has Nb7 at -117, c4 at -183 and Nf7 at -194. The pawn had been attacked from f3 already. The position merits a later endpoint check for an ordinary retreat versus continued tactical necessity.

reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 35 starting roots and every later legal root independently replayed. Immediate Qxf2 loses in the saved comparison. At the fourth move Ke2 is also playable against Qf4+. The played Kg2 allows Qd2+, and supplemental all-six-root analysis at 1.5 million nodes finds only Kf1 viable. The other five moves lose the e1-rook or expose it to a decisive capture.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Qxf2 is a genuine queen-for-rook offer after the countercheck, and Kxf2 also recovers the accepting pawn. The strongest reply after Kg2 remains precise. The played Kf1 protects e1. Supplemental screening after Kf1 finds Qxa2 and several queen checks comparable, while the played Qd3+ has multiple viable evasions. reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bxf3 prepares Qe2#. Rxf3 captures the bishop and accepts the rook loss after Qxf3. Immediate b8=Q is needed for recovery. Kd2 then answers Qxe4+ and Kc3 preserves the knight under Qxd5+.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Independently replayed all 46 legal solver roots on the four submitted steps. Nineteen of the 22 initial moves allow immediate mate, including the tempting b8=Q. Rb2 and Re3 are inferior in the reviewed lines. After Qxf3, no alternative to b8=Q holds. After Qxe4+, Kf2 and Kd1 are viable but yield ongoing queen checks. After Qxd5+, the bounded alternatives to Kc3 lose the knight or otherwise concede a decisive advantage.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Independently replayed all 91 legal replies in the submitted line. Qxf3 and the strong checking declines Qh1+ and Qg1+ were examined. After the last Kc3, Qd4+ is a relevant forcing reply. At 1M nodes across all three legal evasions, only Kb4 holds (-28 nominal cp; Kc2 -437 and Kb3 -455). It is a distinct fifth decision. An added 750k all-root check after Kb4 Qc5+ allows both Kb3 and Kc3 near equality; an amended five-move line would need its own full review.
